en: Due to the fact that the rural population is looking for work in the urban areas, there is also a serious problem of alienation in the regions of the four countries alone. Half of the districts of Takashi and Dejishima are over-difficult areas and the proportion of the population living in those areas is much higher than the Japanese average.

zh: 高知县的大川村是四国过疏地区严峻现状的缩影。
en: The village of Ogawa, Takashi County, is a microcosm of the grim state of affairs in the Qatar regions.

zh: 该村在1960年时有人口4,114人，此后因早明浦水库的建设和白泷矿山关闭而人口急剧减少。
en: Since 1960, when the village had a population of 4,114, the population has been drastically reduced as a result of the construction of the water reservoir in Harumipur and the closure of the Platinum mine.

zh: 2015年人口普查时，大川村只有人口397人，是日本除了离岛之外人口最少的自治体。
en: At the time of the 2015 census, there were only 397 people in Ogawa village, the smallest autonomous population in Japan except for the islands.

zh: 国家安全会议（通称国安会）为中华民国总统决定国防、外交、两岸关系及国家重大变故等与国家安全有关大政方针之咨询机关，前身为1952年设立的国防会议，在1966年3月《临时条款》第三次修订后改设动员戡乱时期国家安全会议，至1991年依《宪法增修条文》规定改组为国家安全会议，1993年正式法制化。
en: The National Security Council (known as the National Security Council) is the advisory body of the President of the Republic of China on the general policy of national security, such as defence, foreign affairs, cross-Strait relations and major changes in the country. The National Defence Council, which was established in 1952, was re-established in March 1966, following the third revision of the Interim Provisions, as well as the National Security Conference in the period of mobilisation, which was restructured into the National Security Council in 1991, as provided for in the Additional Constitutional Provisions, and was formalized in 1993.

zh: 国安会设秘书长一人，职责为承总统之令，依国安会之决议处理会务，并指挥、监督所属职员；此外，还设有咨询委员一职，由总统特聘之。
en: The National Security Council is composed of a Secretary-General, acting on the orders of the President, who is responsible for the conduct of its business in accordance with the resolutions of the National Security Council and who directs and supervises its staff. In addition, there is an advisory council appointed by the President.

zh: 国安会开会时由总统主席，下设有秘书处，另有国家安全局（通称国安局）为国安会之附属机关。
en: The National Security Council is convened by the President with a secretariat and the National Security Agency (known as the National Security Agency) as a subsidiary organ of the Council.

zh: 飓风埃丝特是美国海军和气象局合作执行的破风计划的首批实验目标之一，这一实验旨在通过找到改变或削弱飓风强度的方法。
en: Hurricane Esther was one of the first experimental objectives of the United States Navy and Meteorological Service ' s collaborative storm programme, which was aimed at finding ways to change or reduce the intensity of the hurricane.

zh: 9月16日，一架海军飞机飞入埃丝特位于波多黎各东北方向约645公里外的风眼中，向风暴中投放多罐碘化银。
en: On 16 September, a naval aircraft flew into the wind eye of Esther, some 645 kilometres north-east of Puerto Rico, throwing multiple cans of silver iodide into the storm.

zh: 根据当时的报告，飓风似乎有减弱了约10个百分点。
en: According to the report at that time, the hurricane appeared to have weakened by about 10 percentage points.

zh: 但是，这一过程只是临时性的，风暴很快就恢复到了原有的强度。
en: However, the process was temporary and the storm quickly recovered to its original intensity.

zh: 另一架海军飞机次日再次飞入风暴中投放碘化银，但由于没有成功进入风眼，所以对风暴结构没有产生影响，风暴仍然在继续增强。
en: Another naval aircraft once again dropped silver iodide in the storm the next day, but did not have an impact on the storm structure because it failed to reach the wind eye, and the storm continued to increase.

zh: 虽然结果并不理想，但实验还是被认为获得了成功，破风计划也在之后于1962年建立。
en: Although the results were not ideal, the experiment was considered to have been successful, and the Typhoon Project was subsequently established in 1962.

zh: 1962年1月，企业号航母展开处女航，麦凯恩的姓氏引起舰长注意，还成为船上其他官兵眼里的名人。
en: In January 1962, the Enterprise carrier sailed a virgin voyage, and McCain ' s surname was brought to the attention of the captain and became a celebrity for the rest of the crew on board.

zh: 1962年6月，他升任上尉，同年10月古巴导弹危机爆发时，企业号协助执行海上封锁任务，麦凯恩在此期间负责在舰上发布警报。
en: In June 1962, he was promoted to the rank of captain, and in October of that year, when the Cuban missile crisis broke out, Enterprise assisted in the maritime blockade, during which time McCain was responsible for issuing an alert on board the ship.

zh: 1963年11月，他被转回陆地，在彭萨科拉的海军航空兵基本训练指挥部服役9个月。
en: In November 1963, he was transferred back to land and served for nine months at the Command for the Basic Training of Naval Aviation Personnel in Pensacola.

zh: 1964年9月，他成为密西西比州梅瑞迪恩海军航空站VT-7训练中队的飞行教官，这里还有以他爷爷命名的麦凯恩飞行场。
en: In September 1964, he became a flight instructor at the VT-7 training squadron at the Meredian Naval Air Station, Mississippi, where he also had the McCain flight grounds named after his grandfather.

zh: 除了单个蛋白质以外，还有一些蛋白质复合物可以与外切体相互作用。
en: In addition to individual proteins, there are a number of protein compounds that can interact with the outer body.

en: One of these is the cell-based Ski compound, which contains a RNA spiral enzyme and is involved in the degradation of the RNA.

en: In the cytonucleus, the degradation of rRNA and the small nucleotide RNA is carried out under the guidance of the TRAMP compound.

zh: 南北朝时期的饮食文化呈现出鲜明的南北分野与民族融合特征。
en: The food culture of the North-South era was marked by a distinct North-South divide and ethnic integration.

zh: 北方受游牧民族影响，乳制品（酪、酥）及烤炙肉类（如“羌煮貊炙”）盛行，面食体系进一步发展，出现了发酵面团制作的“蒸饼”与“水引”（早期面条）。
en: The north is influenced by nomadic peoples, where dairy products (cheese, soufflés) and roasted meat (e.g. “cooking”) are prevalent, and pasta systems are further developed, with the emergence of fermented pasta-made “steal cakes” and “water tap” (early noodles).

zh: 南方则延续稻作传统，稻米饭、鱼鲜、蔬果构成主食结构，饮茶之风在江南士族间逐渐普及。
en: In the south, the tradition of rice continued, with rice rice, fish and vegetables forming the staple food structure, and tea-drinking winds were spreading among the Gangans.

zh: 随着人口南迁与佛教传播，素斋技艺提升，豆制品加工趋于精细。
en: As the population moved southward with the spread of Buddhism, the skills of Susai increased and the processing of beans improved.

zh: 饮食器具上，北方多厚重陶器与金属器，南方青瓷食具更为精巧。
en: On the diets, heavy pottery and metal in the north, the southern cuisine is more sophisticated.

en: The pattern of the “hohan mix” diet during this period has laid the foundation for the flourishing of the food culture in Tung Tong, reflecting the dynamic process of cultural interaction during the divided period.

zh: 台风查特安（在菲律宾又名台风格洛丽亚）是密克罗尼西亚联邦楚克州历史上致死人数最多的自然灾害。
en: Typhoon Chatham (also known as Loria in the Philippines) is the most deadly natural disaster in the history of Chuk State in the Federated States of Micronesia.

en: The system took shape on 28 June 2002 near the Federated States of Micronesia, after which it continued to travel for many days and to generate heavy rainfall on the ground.

zh: 楚克州的24小时最高降雨量达506毫米，超过当地月均降雨总量。
en: The maximum 24-hour rainfall of 506 mm in Chuk region exceeds the average monthly rainfall of the region.

zh: 降水引发深度达1.5米的洪水，导致岛上各地发生多起山体滑坡，密克罗尼西亚联邦所受损失总额超过1亿美元。
en: Precipitation caused flooding at a depth of 1.5 metres, resulting in several landslides across the island and losses to the Federated States of Micronesia totalling over $100 million.

en: Andersen intervened, using his mental ability to sense Kai's mind, to learn that the building was the production and marketing centre for slow motion.

en: Andersen offered to hide and wait for support, but Dredd insisted on going upstairs and hunting the horses.

en: Judge Walter and Guthrie received a call from Dredd for help and arrived before the building, but the computer expert from the horseman claimed that the building security system had broken down and refused to open the door for both to enter.

en: A group of young armed men approached Dredd and Andersen, and Kai was able to escape and subdue Anderson, and then used her as a hostage to flee to the base of the top horse.

en: By 26 June, the Joint Typhoon Alert Centre considered Hal to have disappeared, while the Japan Meteorological Agency followed and stopped monitoring the following day.

en: Tiri entered the United States Naval Academy at a time when the civil war was raging, graduated after the war and gradually promoted into the military.

en: During his tenure as captain, he was involved in military repression following the 1877 railway strike.

en: During the civil war in Chile in 1891, he, together with the navy and marines, protected the United States Consulate in San Diego de Chile.

en: During the United States-Western war, Tiley led the Newport gunboat to the successful capture of two Spanish naval vessels.

en: Following the end of the war, he became the first acting Governor of Tutuila and Manua Islands (later American Samoa) and set legal and administrative precedents in the new Territory.

en: Gender Distortion attracted about 6.8 million families to watch during the United States premiere, followed by a mixed assessment of the sudden endings of “Saviours of the sky”.

en: After being informed of the objectives of the coalition, the elected commander and his joint commander, Field Marshal Marçan, dispatched Count Arco to consolidate and defend the Sheron Heights above the town, starting from their main camp in Dillingen, with an advance force of 12,000 men.

en: In order to avoid a protracted siege, Malboro decided to launch a rapid attack before the position became indestructible.

en: After the fall of Singapore, Bath Wah was initially held in Hoyo prison and, together with seven other Brigadier Generals, a colonel, his deputy and a catering sergeant, was placed in a former married prison staff dormitory, sitting outside the dormitory with his hands on his cheeks.

en: In March of the following year, Eisenhower interviewed Harold McMillen, the new British Prime Minister, in Bermuda, to propose the deployment of a United States long-range ballistic missile to the United Kingdom, which would be a later “Emily Plan”.

en: The designers had also considered increasing the calibre of the torpedo-protected craft from 88 mm (3.5 inches) to 105 mm (4.1 inches), but had finally decided to abandon the change because the increased weight would require a reduction in the number of guns.

en: On 30 August, a United States naval vessel reported a wind force of about 510 km east of the island of Antigua and a low-pressure area, which was considered by the meteorological forecast department to be a tropical storm with a wind speed of 110 km per hour and named “Digs”.

zh: 风暴在向西北偏西方向前进的过程中快速增强到飓风强度，以风速每小时210公里强度在北小安的列斯群岛以北近海经过，导致成千上万的居民无家可归，估计损失达到100万美元（1950年美元，相当于1338万2026年美元），被认为是安提瓜历史上破坏最严重的飓风。
en: The storm rapidly increased its intensity towards the north-west, passing at a wind speed of 210 kilometres per hour off the coast of the small northern Antilles, leaving thousands of people homeless, with losses estimated at $1 million (1950 dollars, equivalent to $13.38 million,2026), considered to be the most devastating hurricane in Antigua ' s history.

zh: 游戏中玩家可以找到绿色、蓝色和红色的宝箱，每个箱子中都有同种颜色的球体。

en: Although he subsequently fully recovered and returned to Hong Kong to continue his work, as he grew older, he became less motivated and was no longer fit to renew the Governor ' s term of office.

en: In early 1982, the British Government announced that he would leave Hong Kong on 29 April of the same year to return to Hong Kong and end his career as Governor of Hong Kong, but that on 18 April he had suddenly suffered a slight stroke while on leave at the Pink Hills villa and was taken to Elishaber Hospital for treatment.

en: Tropical cyclones in the current season have resulted in 88 deaths and economic losses amounting to $38.5 million (1950 dollars, equivalent to $515 million in 2026).

en: Hurricane Albert, the first officially named Atlantic hurricane in history, formed on 12 August, wiped the coast of North Carolina and then crossed the Atlantic Provinces of Canada.

en: Two major hurricanes landed in one year, making 1945-1950 the first in history to have landed in the United States in five years, a record that has been maintained for half a century until 2000-2005.

zh: 全年最后一个气旋是场没有命名的热带风暴，于11月13日消散。

zh: 莱蒙案的判决结果至今仍是确定各州行为是否违反政教分离条款的核心，根据裁决，不违反政教分离条款的法律必须具有世俗的立法目的，主要效果不能促进或限制任何宗教，而且不会导致政府过度卷入宗教事务。
en: The outcome of the Lemont judgement remains at the heart of the determination of whether the conduct of the cantons is contrary to the provisions of secularism, according to which the law that does not violate the provisions of secularism must have a secular legislative purpose, the main effect of which is not to promote or restrict any religion and does not lead to excessive involvement of the Government in religious affairs.

en: Before William II was crowned the German Emperor in June 1888, the main objective of the Imperial Navy was to defend the German coastline, for which Leo von Caprivi, then Minister of the Imperial Navy, had ordered a number of shore defence ships in the 1880s.

en: In August 1888, King William II of Germany, with a strong interest in naval affairs, appointed Lieutenant General Alexander von Muntz to replace Caprivi and instructed him to include four battleships in the 1889-1890 naval budget.

en: Müntze is more inclined to form warships than the coastal defence strategy highlighted by his predecessor, who cancelled the last four seaships authorized by Caprivi and ordered four tons of warships.

zh: 尽管它们是德国的第一款现代战列舰，为提尔皮茨时代的公海舰队奠定了基础，但这批舰只仅是作为常规造舰计划的一部分而授权，反映了19世纪80年代由绿水学派等理论引起的战略和战术混乱。

en: On 22 July 1986, the two defendants decided to use the Alford clause to plead guilty to the poisoning of Salmonella and other charges in order to obtain a lighter sentence.

zh: 他的任期被烙上了战略实验的印记，这是由于水下武器造成的威胁日益增加，而新的拿骚级战列舰太宽而无法通过威廉皇帝运河。
en: His term of office was marked by strategic experiments because of the growing threat posed by underwater weapons and the fact that the new Nassau class battleship was too wide to pass through the Emperor William's Canal.

en: As a result, the fleet site was transferred from Kiir to Port William on 1 April 1910.

en: As part of the subsequent facilitation of the railway expansion of the Taidong line, the retrofitting of stations along the route has generally resulted in the adoption of designs with uniform specifications, resulting in the so-called “Standard Easter Station”.

en: However, while site standardization has not yet been fully implemented on the early north line, similar replicas and styles can be found: For example, the Hampton station has the same design as the Yongchun station, which corresponds to the South Australian station, and the Jin Station mirror replicating the war tower station, while the East Australian station has a similar station configuration to the Zonta station.

en: An Exxon oil platform parked off Pensacola, Florida, was ripped from its berths by the wind and was missing by 2 September, after which the aircraft of the Coast Guard was found 23 kilometres away.

en: The court sentenced him to 10 years' probation, a $400,000 fine and deported him from the United States for the next five years.

zh: 7月16日，美国空军的克拉克空军基地所有活动均被取消，而应急救援和清理小组则处于待命状态，而所有非必要人员则需留在家中。
en: On 16 July, all activities of the Clark Air Base of the United States Air Force were cancelled, while emergency rescue and clearance teams were on standby, while all non-essential personnel remained at home.

en: The four counties around Albany, Skenektadi, Renselle and Saratoga have high levels of water in their snowfalls, and occasionally also with rain and snow.

en: This has resulted in snow being more dense and difficult to clear than usual, with some sections remaining uncleaned after a month, and a record $2 million (in 1969 US$ 1,756,000, or $2026) spent on snow removal.

en: As a result of the Sasakawa regime's subjugation of the Deangs, the Deangs moved in large numbers; as a result of the oppression of the Toms, the Deangs moved in large numbers for the second time, the Deangs in Man City almost disappeared, leaving only 1,854 people in 1952.

zh: 四川李白研究会成立于1984年，是今中国最早成立的李白研究机构，秘书处设于江油市李白纪念馆，每隔两年举办一次李白文化学术会议。

en: Hurricane Florida in 1941, a powerful tropical cyclone that affected the Bahamas, Florida and the south-eastern United States in October 1941, was the fifth known storm of the Atlantic hurricane season in 1941, first discovered north of the Virgin Islands on 3 October.

zh: 风暴大致上向西行进并穿越巴哈马，最高风速高达190公里，这个数值相当于萨菲尔-辛普森飓风等级中的三级飓风的标准，不过此等级当时还没有问世。
en: The storm moved about westward and crossed the Bahamas at a maximum wind speed of 190 km, a value equivalent to the standard of hurricane level 3 in Hurricane Safer-Simpson, although that level had not yet been known.

zh: 越过佛罗里达州南部后，飓风进入墨西哥湾，并沿佛罗里达州的西北狭长地带实现再次登陆。
en: After crossing the southern part of Florida, the hurricane entered the Gulf of Mexico and reached a new landing along the north-west strip of Florida.

zh: 她在序言中这样写道：“我的主要论点建基于这样的一个简单原理，即如果女性没有通过教育作好成为男性伴侣的准备时，她的知识与美德便会停止进步；真理必然对所有的人都有效”，沃斯通克拉夫特认为，当一个社会缺乏受过教育的女性时，那么这个社会便会退化：这主要是因为年幼子女启蒙教师的这一社会角色大都由母亲担任。

zh: 她将未受教育女性的问题归因于男性，是“一套错误的教育体系；而这套错误的教育体系，来源于一些讨论教育问题的书籍，这些书籍的著述者们与其说是把女性当作人来看待，还不如说是当作女人来看待更准确些”。
en: She attributed the problem of uneducated women to men as “an education system that is wrong and which is derived from books that discuss education and whose authors look more accurately as women than as women”.

zh: 女性具有理性思维的能力；只有当男性拒绝为她们提供教育，并鼓励她们轻薄时（沃斯通克拉夫特将愚蠢的女性称作是“哈巴狗”和“玩具”），她们才会看上去不具备此种能力。

en: Typhoon Guay, also known as Cyclone Cavally 1989, was a powerful tropical cyclone on a small scale in November 1989, which claimed more than 800 lives in the Gulf of Thailand and surrounding areas, as well as the typhoon that most affected the Peninsula in 35 years.

en: Nixon has been doing well, not only through scholarships, but also through his election as President of the Duke Bar Association, becoming a member of the Association of Qualifications of the Faculty of Law, and graduated in 1937 with the third full class.

en: In 1904, Stanley successfully led the fund-raising committee to hold public hearings on the monopoly practices of the United States tobacco company, but this failed to persuade members of Congress to abolish the national tobacco tax or to take action against the United States tobacco company.

zh: 刘易斯在书中写道，最高法院大法官路易斯·布兰戴斯和小奥利弗·温德尔·霍姆斯开始对第一修正案赋予的言论自由给出更宽泛的解读。
en: In his book, Lewis wrote that the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, Luis Brandes, and Oliver Wendell Holmes Jr., began to give a broader interpretation of the freedom of expression afforded by the First Amendment.

zh: 霍姆斯在申克诉合众国案的判决书中写道，言论自由必须受到保护，除非某项言论存在“明显而立即的危险”，导致“实质性的罪恶”。
en: In his judgement in Schenk v. United States of America, Holmes wrote that freedom of expression must be protected unless there is a “manifest and immediate danger” to a particular expression, leading to “substantial evil”.

zh: 笔者反思，恐怖主义时代随时都可能会有迫在眉睫的危险，那么对于言论的相应看法又是否应该有所不同。
en: I think that there is an imminent danger of an era of terrorism, and whether the corresponding perception of words should be different.

zh: 麦克维主持的这轮面谈与其说是会议，倒更象是司法听证会，他于次日发信表明立场，称其他制造商都没有反对意见，霍布斯公司的产品销量也不大，如果满意其所有要求，在边缘轮框周围留有明显空隙，或是把印第安人头像的颧骨部分磨平，这会影响硬币的艺术价值：“因此，请您着手生产新版镍币。”
en: The round of interviews conducted by McVeigh, which was more like a judicial hearing than a meeting, took a stand the following day when he sent a letter stating that there was no objection from the other manufacturers, that Hobbs had no substantial sales of its products and that, if satisfied with all of its requirements, there was a clear gap around the edge bars, or that the skeletal parts of the Indian head were to be flattened, it would affect the artistic value of coins: “So please proceed with the production of the new version of nickels.”

zh: 购买奥利弗打字机的客户可以选择橄榄绿或镀镍机身，键盘也有白色或黑色两种。
en: A customer who buys Oliver typewriters can choose olive green or nickel-plating body, and there are white or black keyboards.

zh: 从No.3型开始的打字机大多漆成绿色，但也有销往气温较高或潮湿地区的变种机型表面是镀铬工艺。
en: Typewriters starting from type No.3 are mostly painted green, but there are also variant surfaces that are sold to higher temperatures or wet areas that are chromium plating.

zh: 从No.11型开始，机身颜色从绿色改为黑色。
en: Starting with the No.11 type, the body colour was changed from green to black.

zh: 英国奥利弗打字机公司在第二次世界大战期间为满足政府战争需要而生产的机器表面有抛光工艺处理，称为“战争抛光”。
en: British Oliver typewriters produced during the Second World War to meet the needs of government wars had a surfacing process called “war polishing”.

zh: 19至20世纪年间，许多澳大利亚男性原住民成为该国农牧产业的饲育员并发挥重要作用，还会参加饲育员技能竞赛表演（人称狂野骑士）。
en: Between the 19th and 20th centuries, many male First Nations of Australia became feeders and played an important role in the country ' s agro-pastoral industry, and also participated in a skills contest (known as the Wild Knight).

zh: 成为演员前，多德做过饲育员、驯马师和牛仔竞技骑手，其间还有段时间为骑手兼艺人斯默基·道森工作。
en: Before becoming an actor, Dodger worked as a feeder, a horse trainer and a cowboy racer, with some time spent working for the rider and artist, Smoky Dawson.

zh: 多德是澳大利亚狂野骑士协会的一员，还曾在1964年卡尔加里牛仔节上表演。
en: Dodd, a member of the Australian Wild Knights Association, also performed at the Calgary Cowboy Festival in 1964.

zh: 汉纳家族的多名成员曾投资在新里斯本修建运河，此举能够大幅缩短当地到俄亥俄河的行程。
en: Several members of the Hanna family had invested in the construction of a canal in New Lisbon, which could significantly shorten the local journey to the Ohio River.

zh: 项目此后以惨败告终，家族为此损失大笔资金，大部分成员于是在19世纪50年代初离开新里斯本。
en: The project ended with a tragic loss of funds for the family, most of whom left New Lisbon in the early 1950s.

zh: 伦纳德同兄弟罗伯特合伙，开始在克里夫兰经营杂货店，马克也在1852年同家人迁居该市。
en: Leonard, in partnership with his brother Robert, started running a grocery store in Cleveland, and Mark moved with his family to the city in 1852.

zh: 接下来马克先后进入多所公立学校就读，其中包括克里夫兰中央高中，和约翰·戴维森·洛克菲勒是同学。
en: Mark then entered several public schools, including Cleveland Central High School, and John Davidson Rockefeller.

zh: 1857年高中毕业后，汉纳进入凯斯西储大学，但因推动他人一起嘲笑学校某个严肃仪式而被开除。
en: After graduating from high school in 1857, Hannay entered Keys West Provident University but was expelled for promoting others to mock some serious ceremony at the school.

zh: 离开学校后，他在家族企业中从事各种工作，从最基层开始一步步学习。
en: After leaving school, he worked in various jobs in family enterprises, starting at the lowest level.

zh: 1932年，约翰·霍培尔当选为第十二选区众议员，但在任期间他因试图出售一个西点军校提名而被法院定罪，这样到了1936年，他已经成了一个没有取胜希望的候选人。
en: In 1932, John Hopper was elected to the twelfth constituency, but during his term of office he was convicted by the courts for attempting to sell the nomination of a Western Point military academy, making him a unsuccessful candidate by 1936.

zh: 沃里斯在民主党初选中就击败了霍培尔，并在之后的普选中轻松取胜，上任后他获得了良好的评价，非常忠实地支持罗斯福新政，新闻界给他起了个绰号叫“阿特拉斯小子”，似乎要把整个世界的重量都挑到自己的肩膀上。
en: Wallis defeated Hopper in the Democratic Party’s first election and won easily in the subsequent general elections. After taking office, he was given a good credit for his very faithful support for Roosevelt’s new deal, and the press gave him a nickname called “Atlas Kid”, which seems to put the weight of the world on his shoulder.

zh: 德斯蒙德·休谟告诉查理·佩斯自己最新的预感：如果查理潜入某达摩计划工作站，然后在打开某个开关后淹死，那么查理的女友克莱尔·李特顿（艾米莉·德瑞文饰）和孩子亚伦就会乘直升机逃离这个岛。
en: Desmond Humu told Charlie Pess his latest hunch that if Charlie infiltrated a Dharma project station and drowned after opening a switch, Charlie's girlfriend, Claire Ritterton, and the kid Aaron, would get out of the island by helicopter.

zh: 萨伊德告诉杰克，自己或许可以和离岸约130公里的一艘货船取得联系。
en: Sayid told Jack that he might be able to contact a cargo ship about 130 kilometres offshore.

zh: 他需要先到无线电发射塔那里关闭卢棱的求救信号，然后再用纳奥米·杜丽（玛莎·托马森饰）的卫星电话同外界联系。
en: He needed to go to the radio tower to shut down Lupurin's distress signal before contacting the outside world with Naomi Douri's satellite phone.

zh: 但茱莉叶·柏克（伊丽莎白·米切尔饰）告诉萨伊德，达摩计划还有一个水下工作站，其功能是阻断一切对外联络，所以他的计划不会成功。
en: But Juliet Burke told Sayid that the Dharma Plan also had an underwater workstation whose function was to block all external contacts, so his plan would not succeed.

zh: 萨伊德很快想到，自己70天前发现的那条电缆应该就是通往这个工作站，而且他们需要有人潜入工作站将之关闭，但这样的任务很可能有去无回，查理于是主动请缨。
en: Sayid quickly realized that the cable that he discovered 70 days ago should be leading to the station and that they needed someone to infiltrate the station and shut it down, but such a mission was likely to go nowhere and Charlie volunteered.

zh: 1967年1月16日，总统林登·约翰逊提名康布斯担任联邦第六巡回上诉法院法官，接替前一年11月下旬去世的法官小沙克福尔德·米勒。
en: On 16 January 1967, President Linden Johnson nominated Combus to serve as a judge of the Federal Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit, replacing Judge Shack Ford Miller Jr., who passed away in late November of the previous year.

zh: 联邦参议院于1967年4月5日确认了这一提名。
en: The Federal Senate confirmed the nomination on 5 April 1967.

zh: 根据联邦司法部门的规定，康布斯必须清算自己的业务和银行资产，还需要严格限制与政治熟人间的接触，来避免今后可能需要作出裁决案件中的潜在利益冲突。
en: According to the federal judiciary, Combus must liquidate his business and banking assets and also strictly restrict contacts with political acquaintances to avoid potential conflicts of interest in cases that may require future decisions.

zh: 他曾表示对自己上任后经手的案件经常会进一步上诉到联邦最高法院感到失望和无奈，这也经常导致上诉法院的意见得不到足够的重视。
en: He has expressed disappointment and frustration that the cases he has handled since taking office are often subject to further appeals to the Federal Supreme Court, which often results in insufficient weight being given to the opinion of the Court of Appeal.

zh: 1970年6月5日，康布斯辞去法官职务，然后前往路易斯维尔，成为塔兰特、康布斯和布利特（之后更名为怀亚特、塔兰特和康布斯）律师事务所的合伙人。
en: On 5 June 1970, Combus resigned as a judge and then went to Louisville to become a partner with the law firms of Tarrant, Combus and Brit (later renamed Wyatt, Tarrant and Combus).

zh: 原来的维多利亚十字勋章是由维多利亚女王于1856年引入，旨在奖励克里米亚战争中的英勇行为。
en: The original Victoria Cross was introduced by Queen Victoria in 1856 to reward bravery in the Crimean War.

zh: 该勋章前后共25次授予给24位新西兰军人，其中查尔斯·阿珀姆上尉曾于第二次世界大战期间两次获奖。
en: The Order was awarded to 24 New Zealand military personnel 25 times before and after the Order, of which Captain Charles Amber was awarded two awards during the Second World War.

zh: 二战结束后，新西兰军人一共只获得过14枚维多利亚十字勋章。
en: After World War II, New Zealand military personnel received only 14 Victoria Crosses.

zh: 该奖章由青铜制成，据称来源于塞瓦斯托波尔围城战期间被缴获的武器，但多位历史学家都对此提出了质疑。
en: The medal was made of copper, allegedly from weapons seized during the siege in Sevastopol, which was questioned by several historians.

zh: 起初所有英联邦国家的获奖者获得的都是同样的奖章，但从二十世纪九十年代开始，多个英联邦国家相继建立了独立的授勋系统，其中有三个仍然将“维多利亚十字”几个字保留在其最高英勇奖章的名称中。
en: Initially all the recipients of the Commonwealth received the same medals, but since the 1990s, several Commonwealth countries have successively established independent awards, three of which still keep the words “Victorian Cross” in the name of their highest medal of heroism.

zh: 虽然无意竞选州长，但布朗还是与帕克·沃特金斯·哈丁、前联邦众议员威廉·J·斯通以及州参议院临时议长威廉·格贝尔一起成为首轮投票的候选人。
en: Brown, along with Parker Watkins Hardin, former Federal Representative William J. Stone and the President ad interim of the State Senate, William Gerber, were candidates for the first round of voting, although not intended to run for Governor.

zh: 斯通和格贝尔之间达成了一个众所周知的协定，旨在令哈丁出局，但这个计划没有成功，大会也随之陷入混乱。
en: There was a well-known agreement between Stone and Gber to get Hadeen out of the game, but the plan was unsuccessful and the General Assembly went into chaos.

zh: 之后的四天时间（星期日除外）里，大会举行了数轮投票，但没有任何一位候选人赢得超半数选票，而布朗则在每一轮投票中都获得了少数支持。
en: Over the next four days, except on Sunday, the Assembly held several rounds of balloting, but none of the candidates won more than half of the votes, while Brown received a minority of support in each ballot.

zh: 最终大会代表决定在之后的每轮投票淘汰得票最少的候选人，直到有候选人得到超半数支持为止，经过几轮投票，格贝尔最终获得了提名。
en: In the end, the delegates decided to phase out the lowest number of candidates in each subsequent ballot until more than half of the candidates received support, and after several rounds of voting, Gber was finally nominated.

zh: 曼联边锋博洛姆克维斯特因足踝受伤倦勤，而中场基恩则是自11个月前韧带撕裂后伤愈复出的首场正式比赛。
en: The United Mansion has been tired of his ankle injury in Bolumkvist, while Keane in the middle is the first formal match to recover from the tearing of his ligament 11 months ago.

zh: 于1998年5月新加盟曼联的后卫斯塔姆，首度为新东家上场，伙拍鲁尼·约翰森镇守中路。
en: In May 1998, the rear guard of the New Union of Mansion came for the first time to the home of the new easterly, with the town of Ronny Johansen guarding the midway.

zh: 阿森纳方面，虽然外界预期新援维瓦兹将会出任首发，但最终只列替补，并未安排落场，而博格坎普则伙拍阿内尔卡担任首发前锋。
en: On the Arsenal side, while it is expected that the new Vivaz will be launched, it will eventually be replaced and not scheduled, while Bogkamp will be in the vanguard of Anelka.

zh: 这场地震共计造成了约9100万美元（2002年美元，相当于1.63亿2026年美元）的损失。
en: The total cost of the earthquake was approximately $91 million (2002 dollars, equivalent to $163,2026 dollars).

zh: 许多地区都可以感觉到这次地震，包括加兹温省、吉兰省、库尔德斯坦省、赞詹省和哈马丹省，其中加兹温受到的打击最为惨重，一位没有透露姓名的该省官员表示，全省共有177人遇难。
en: The earthquake was felt in many areas, including Ghazwin, Gilan, Kurdistan, Zangan and Hamadan provinces, where Ghazwin was hardest hit, with an unnamed provincial official indicating that 177 people had been killed across the province.

zh: 震中以东约290千米的伊朗首都德黑兰也有震感，不过当地没有报道出现严重损失。
en: Tehran, the capital of Iran, about 290 km east of the earthquake, also experienced shock, although no serious damage was reported.

zh: 不过，该国记者博尔祖·达拉加希报道称，自己在德黑兰看到建筑物摇晃和玻璃破碎。
en: However, the country ' s journalist, Borzu Daragashi, reported that he had seen buildings shaking and broken glass in Tehran.

zh: 不过，加布里埃尔认为穆罕默德未能在武侯德战役采用原本拟定的战术。
en: Gabriel believed, however, that Mohamed had failed to use the tactics originally devised during the Vaud campaign.

zh: 麦地那的地形能阻碍大批骑兵和步兵，削弱麦加一方的人数优势，而且他们缺乏攻城武器，只要穆斯林坚守不出，麦加军队自然会因军饷耗尽而退兵，但穆罕默德最终却同意了部下出战的请求。
en: The terrain in Medina can impede large numbers of cavalry and infantry, weaken the strength of the Mecca side, and they lack the weapons to attack the city. As long as Muslims fail, the Makkah army will naturally withdraw from the army as long as it runs out of salary, but Mohammed eventually agrees with his men's requests to fight.

zh: 即使穆罕默德叮嘱了驻守一个小山丘上的弓兵不得擅离，他们后来没有遵从这个命令，麦加军队有机可乘，得以从后方攻击穆斯林。
en: Even if Mohammed had told the bowmen stationed on a small hill not to leave, they had subsequently failed to comply with that order and the Makkah army was able to attack Muslims from behind.

zh: 多默里及其他被俘的奥什号船员之后的情况没有记录，获释后他究竟是回到了法国或波兰，还是留在利物浦也无从得知。
en: The circumstances of Domory and the other captured Osh crew were not recorded and it was not known whether he had returned to France or Poland after his release or remained in Liverpool.

zh: 查尔斯·多默里的故事曾于1852年引起了英国作家查尔斯·狄更斯的注意并因此而短暂回到公众的视野。
en: The story of Charles Domory attracted the attention of the British writer Charles Dickens in 1852 and briefly returned to the public eye as a result.

zh: 狄更斯认为，让一个多默里这样的人到德鲁里巷的舞台上当众用餐，效果一定远胜于单纯的一部悲剧，因为他咀嚼的是有益健康的牛肉，而不是虚无飘渺的词语。
en: Dickens believes that having a man like Domory eat in public on the stage of the Druri Lane must have been far more effective than simply a tragedy, because he chews healthy beef, not an empty word.

zh: 6月18日下午，日军侦察机发现美军第58特遣舰队。
en: On the afternoon of 18 June, a Japanese reconnaissance aircraft discovered the United States military task force 58.

zh: 小泽治三郎欲善用日机较远的续航距离，命舰队避开美军攻击范围，留待19日与关岛的日机一举进攻；而此时斯普鲁恩斯仍未得悉日军舰队确实位置。
en: In order to make good use of the distance of the Japanese aircraft, Samurai Ozawa left the fleet out of the range of the United States military and waited for 19 days for the Japanese aircraft to attack Guam.

zh: 米契尔于半夜提议舰队向西前进，使航空母舰可赶及在19日早上进入作战半径，派飞机攻击日军舰队，但斯普鲁恩斯以掩护塞班岛登陆部队为先，命舰队于晚上继续向东撤，待日出后才再向西推进，以免遭遇日军埋伏。
en: In the middle of the night, Mitchell proposed to move the fleet westward so that the carrier could reach the operational radius in the morning of 19 September and send an aircraft to attack the Japanese fleet, but Spruance, first to cover the landing force on Seban Island, ordered the fleet to move east at night and then to move west until sunrise, in order to avoid a Japanese ambush.

zh: 日出前，日军侦察机多次发现美军舰队，但美军仍未掌握日军动向。
en: Before sunrise, Japanese reconnaissance aircraft repeatedly found the United States fleet, but the United States forces still did not have control of the movements of the Japanese.

zh: 次日菲律宾海海战爆发。
en: The following day, naval warfare broke out in the Philippines.

zh: 1916年1月，海军中将赖因哈德·舍尔成为公海舰队总司令。
en: In January 1916, Lieutenant General Reinhard Schell became Commander-in-Chief of the High Seas Fleet.

zh: 经历了1916年5月31日－6月1日的日德兰海战后，舍尔力推更新、更强大的战列舰，这与德皇威廉二世所号召、称为“一体化的战列舰”相符，将战列舰的装甲和火力与战列巡洋舰的速度结合在一起。
en: After the war of 31 May to 1 June 1916 in the Zhedran Sea, the Sheller pushed for a renewed and stronger battleship, which was consistent with what King William II called the “integrated battleship”, combining the armour and fire of the battleship with the speed of the battle cruiser.

zh: 而海军指挥部的另一个派系，负责领导国家海军办公室的国务大臣、海军上将爱德华·冯·卡佩勒则反对这一想法，并青睐于传统的、差异化的主力舰设计。
en: Yet another faction of the Navy Command, the Minister of State, Admiral Edward von Capelle, who heads the National Naval Office, opposes the idea and favours the traditional and differentiated mastership design.

zh: 尽管如此，舍尔还是主张新舰应拥有420毫米口径的主炮、350毫米厚的装甲带、速度可达32节（59千米每小时）以及最大排水量接近于50000吨。
en: Nevertheless, Shell maintains that the new vessel should have 420 mm of main artillery, 350 mm thick armor belts, speeds of up to 32 knots (59 km per hour) and a maximum drainage of close to 50,000 tons.

zh: 全新的420毫米炮是在1916年12月29日设计，至1918年9月11日获批，然而却并未实际建造。
en: The completely new 420-mm gun was designed on 29 December 1916 and approved on 11 September 1918, but was not actually constructed.

zh: 真菌性脑膜炎（如隐球菌脑膜炎等）需以高剂量长期的抗真菌药物治疗，如两性霉素B和氟胞嘧啶。
en: fungal meningitis (e.g., hidden fungus meningitis) needs to be treated with high doses of long-term antifluorinated drugs, such as pyrocin B and fluorine.

zh: 颅内压增高在真菌性脑膜炎中很常见，理想情况下建议每天进行腰椎穿刺或腰椎引流以减压。
en: Intracreal pressure increases are common in fungal meningitis and, ideally, daily vertebrae puncture or vertebrae flow is recommended to reduce pressure.

zh: 之后，一位政府官员站在卡车上用扩音器对信众们讲话，要求这批以中学生、大学生为大宗的抗议者离开现场。
en: Subsequently, a government official stood in a truck and spoke with a loudspeaker to the followers, asking the protesters, who were large in secondary school and university students, to leave the scene.

zh: 但当这名官员出口谴责越共作乱时，只是引起群众的满堂倒采。
en: But when the official went out to condemn the Vietcong for their chaos, it only caused the crowd to fall into disarray.

zh: 18时30分，现场的陆军部队开始将红棕色的液体洒到人潮上方，当场造成67人化学外伤，而必须紧急送往医院治疗。
en: At 1830 hours the army forces on the ground began spilling red-brown liquids over the human current, causing on-site chemical trauma to 67 people, who had to be taken to hospital for urgent medical treatment.

zh: 当时伤者出现了皮肤严重起水泡、呼吸道剧痛等症状，示威者对于陆军痛下毒手怒不可遏，进一步扩大了反抗浪潮、并对吴廷琰政府的公关形象造成大灾难。

en: Davis stated that Kentucky had joined the Confederation and could no longer be neutral.

zh: 阿根廷的第2场赛事对墨西哥，获得世界杯史上首个点球，玻利维亚主裁判尤内塞斯·沙乌塞多在本场赛事共吹罚五个点球，当中三个具争议性。
en: For Mexico, Argentina won the first spot in the history of the World Cup, and Bolivia's presiding judge, Eunices Chaucedo, gave five hits in this game, three of which were controversial.

en: Gunamo Starbilt played the hat trick in his international game, and despite the fact that Captain Manuel Ferrero had to return to Buenos Aires to take the legal test, Argentina still won by 6:3.

en: At the end of the course, the team decided who was to be promoted, and Argentina and Chile, on both sides, defeated France and Mexico.

en: After Monty's invasion of Atoro Torres, the match was full of gunpowder.

en: Argentina won the event with 3:1 and promoted four.

zh: 1944年6月，美国陆军航空军第20轰炸机司令部开始从印度东北部的克勒格布尔出动B-29超级堡垒重型轰炸机执行作战任务。
en: In June 1944, the United States Army Air Force 20th Bomber Command began its combat mission with the B-29 Super Fortress heavy bombers from Klegpur, north-eastern India.

zh: 虽然司令部的主要目的是打击日本本土工业目标，但还是有约半数任务旨在支持盟军在太平洋的其他行动。
en: Although the main objective of the Command was to combat indigenous industrial objectives in Japan, about half of the tasks were aimed at supporting other Allied operations in the Pacific.

zh: 第20轰炸机司令部由美国陆军航空军第二十航空队指挥，第二十航空队直接听从华盛顿哥伦比亚特区亨利·阿诺德上将的命令，不像其他作战单位那样由盟军在印度和中国战区的指挥官统领。
en: The 20th Bomber Command is under the command of the 20th United States Army Air Force, which is directly under the command of Admiral Henry Arnold in Washington, D.C., and is not under the command of the Allied commanders in the Indian and Chinese war zones, as is the case with other combat units.

zh: 阿诺德解除第20轰炸机司令部首长职位后，柯蒂斯·李梅于8月29日继任。
en: After Arnold was relieved of his position as head of the 20th Bomber Command, Curtis Lee May succeeded on 29 August.

zh: 因为格雷斯的规模庞大，它在美国东岸产生大的海浪；结合异常高的潮水，这些海浪达到至少4.6米。
en: Because of the size of Grace, it produces large waves on the eastern coast of the United States; combined with exceptionally high tides, these waves reach at least 4.6 metres.

zh: 尽管有轻微的海滩侵蚀，并没有发生实质的财产损失，不过北卡罗来纳州的卡罗莱纳海滩流失了约0.30米厚的沙。
en: Despite minor beach erosion, no substantial property damage was incurred, although the Carolina Beach in North Carolina lost approximately 0.30 metres of sand.

zh: 8月17日，一股东风波离开非洲海岸，于8月24日进入东太平洋并很快开始呈现出发展迹象。
en: On 17 August, a shareholder left the African coast, entered the eastern Pacific on 24 August and soon began to show signs of development.

zh: 当晚，气象部门开始启用德沃夏克分析法对位于哥斯达黎加以西近海，并且还在以每小时15至25公里速度向西北偏西方向移动的这一天气系统进行分析。
en: That evening, the meteorological services began to use the Dvoschak analysis method to analyse this weather system, which is located off the coast of Costa Rica and is moving westward to the northwest at 15 to 25 kilometres per hour.

zh: 外界环境有利于其进一步发展，到8月26日晚，低气压区上空的对流已经有所增加。
en: The external environment was conducive to its further development, and by the night of 26 August, the flow over the low-pressure zone had increased.

zh: 8月27日清晨，系统到达危地马拉西南偏南方向约400公里洋面，其组织性已有所改善，但对流仍然很少。
en: In the early morning hours of 27 August, the system reached about 400 kilometres south-west of Guatemala, which has improved its organization, but the flow remains small.

zh: 8月28日清晨，逐渐组织起来的对流内部已经有了更多的带状特征，美国国家飓风中心将其归类为第十一E号热带低气压。
en: In the early morning hours of 28 August, the increasingly organized convective internal features of the convection, classified by the National Hurricane Center of the United States as tropical low air pressure 11E.

zh: 1882年下半年，巴伯的设计方案得到铸币局官员首肯，还有25枚样币按照惯例送往首都哥伦比亚特区，等待财政部长查尔斯·J·福尔杰批准。
en: In the second half of 1882, Barber ' s design was endorsed by officials of the Castery Bureau, and 25 samples were sent to the capital, District of Columbia, in accordance with established practice, pending approval by the Minister of Finance, Charles J. Forge.

zh: 但让斯诺登意外的是，福尔杰否决了设计，理由是当时已有法律规定，“UNITEDSTATESOFAMERICA”（“美利坚合众国”）字样应该放在硬币背面而非正面，当时的总统切斯特·艾伦·阿瑟也支持部长的看法。
en: What surprised Snowden, however, was that Forger rejected the design on the grounds that there was a legal provision that the words “UNITESTATESEFOMERICA” (“United States of America”) should be placed on the back of the coin rather than on the front, and that the then President, Chester Allen Arthur, also supported the Minister’s view.

zh: 斯诺登建议在此稍作通融，但福尔杰拒绝妥协，巴伯因此按部长的意见修改设计。
en: Snowden suggested a little accommodation here, but Forge refused to compromise, and Barber modified the design as the Minister advised.

zh: 新设计获得批准，镍币准备在1883年初投产。
en: The new design was approved and the nickel is ready for production in early 1883.

zh: 四国山地南侧地区气候炎热、降水充沛，属于太平洋侧气候。
en: The climate on the southern side of the mountain is hot and abundant and belongs to the Pacific.

zh: 这一地区受到黑潮的影响，即使冬季也十分温暖，部分地区全年无霜。
en: The region is affected by the black tide, which is warm even during the winter, and parts of the region are free throughout the year.

zh: 夏季这一地区常是台风的登陆地点，高知县更有“台风银座”之称。
en: In the summer, this area is often a landing site for typhoons, which is more known as the Typhoon Silver Consort.

zh: 神奈川县是日本外国人人口较多的县。
en: Kanagawa County is the country with a large foreign population in Japan.

zh: 2022年时，神奈川县的外国人人口约有22.2万人，占神奈川县总人口的2.41％。
en: In 2022, the population of foreigners in Shinagawa County was approximately 222,000, or 2.41 per cent of the total population in Shinagawa County.

zh: 神奈川县的外国人人口中以中国人最多，约有6.8万人，占外国人的30.8%；越南人、韩国·朝鲜人、菲律宾人的比例亦超过10%。
en: The largest number of foreigners is Chinese, about 68,000, or 30.8 per cent of foreigners, and the proportion of Vietnamese, Korean Koreans and Filipinos exceeds 10 per cent.

zh: 神奈川县的中国人人口最多的行政区是横滨市中区，这里亦是日本最大唐人街横滨中华街的所在地；韩国·朝鲜人人口则以川崎市沿海、横滨市鹤见区等重工业地区较多。
en: The largest Chinese population is located in the central part of the city of Yokohama, which is also the site of China-China Street in Hong Kong, Japan's largest town, and in the more heavily industrial areas, such as the coastal areas of Kawasaki and Yokohama.

zh: 横滨市是神奈川县外国人最多的自治体，集中了神奈川县45%的外国人人口。
en: The city of Yokohama is home to the largest number of foreigners in Kanagawa County, where 45 per cent of the foreign population is concentrated.

zh: 横滨市中区的人口中有8.9%是外国人。
en: In the central part of Yokohama, 8.9 per cent of the population is foreign.

zh: 9月25至26日，由于天气预报中称气旋有可能在新奥尔良附近登陆，因此当地进行了大规模疏散。
en: From 25 to 26 September, large-scale evacuations were carried out as a result of weather forecasts stating that the cyclone was likely to land near New Orleans.

zh: 官方建议生活在新奥尔良的超过150万人离开该市。
en: More than 1.5 million people living in New Orleans were officially advised to leave the city.

zh: 该地区共计开设了9个避难所，可以容纳45万人。
en: A total of 9 shelters have been opened in the region, which can accommodate 450,000 people.

zh: 新奥尔良市长马克·莫里尔宣布该市进入紧急状态，以便飓风过后市内可以立即获得联邦援助，市里还实施了宵禁。
en: The mayor of New Orleans, Marc Morr, declared the city a state of emergency so that federal assistance could be obtained immediately after the hurricane and a curfew imposed.

zh: 1869年，波斯比谢尔获得费城铸币局聘请并迁居该市。
en: In 1869, Persian Bischer was hired by the Philly Founder and moved to the city.

zh: 首席铸币员阿奇博尔德·劳登·斯诺登对波斯比谢尔的表现非常满意，于1872年提升他担任助理铸币员。
en: Chief Founder Archibald Lauden Snowden was very satisfied with the performance of Persian Bischer, who was promoted as Assistant Founder in 1872.

zh: 1876年，斯诺登离开铸币局出任费城邮政署长，总统尤利西斯·辛普森·格兰特提拔波斯比谢尔继任首席铸币员一职。
en: In 1876, Snowden left the Castery as the Post Administrator of Philadelphia, and President Ulysses Simpson Granted to the post of Chief Founder in Perscher.

zh: 格兰特于1876年12月14日提名波斯比谢尔，联邦参议院于12月26日确认提名。
en: Grant nominated Persian Bischer on 14 December 1876, and the Federal Senate confirmed its nomination on 26 December.

zh: 据钱币历史学家昆汀·戴维·鲍尔斯记载，波斯比谢尔担任首席铸币员期间利用铸局厂设施和过期模具制作出罕见的3美元金币，其中包括1873、1875和1876年3种版本。
en: According to the records of the coin historian Quentin David Bowers, during his time as the chief foundr, Persian Bischer made a rare three-dollar gold coin, consisting of 1873, 1875 and 1876 versions, using casting plant facilities and expired moulds.

zh: 波斯比谢尔任职期间，各种图案硬币、再发行币，以及使用不同金属铸造的同形币流入人脉广泛的收藏家和交易商手中，波斯比谢尔本人离职后不久也售出了这些种类硬币的大量私人收藏。
en: During his tenure, various coins, reissues and coins made with different metals went into the hands of a wide range of collectors and dealers, and he himself sold a large private collection of these types of coins shortly after his departure.

zh: 战争开始后，公海舰队采取了突袭英国海岸的策略，试图牵扯英国大舰队的一部分，或迫使英国人分散他们的部队。
en: Following the beginning of the war, the high seas fleet used a strategy of raiding the British coast, attempting to involve part of the British fleet or forcing the British to disperse their forces.

zh: 然后，公海舰队将能够集中自己的兵力摧毁孤立的敌舰，从而减少英国舰队的数量优势。
en: The high seas fleet would then be able to pool its forces to destroy isolated enemy ships, thereby reducing the strength of the British fleet.

zh: 突袭由第一侦察集群的大巡洋舰主导实施，而公海舰队的战列分舰队则从旁支援；类似行动包括1914年11月对雅茅斯的突袭、12月对对斯卡布罗、哈特尔浦和惠特比的突袭，以及1916年4月的炮击雅茅斯和洛斯托夫特。
en: The raids were led by the First Reconnaissance Cluster ' s large cruisers, supported by the high seas fleet ' s battle squads; similar operations included the attack on Yamouth in November 1914, the raid on Skabro, Hartpur and Whitby in December, and the shelling of Yamouth and Lostoft in April 1916.

zh: 在此期间，德国级的全部五艘舰都与舰队共同作战，但预期的战斗在这些行动中未能实现。
en: All five German-class vessels fought with the fleet during this period, but the anticipated fighting did not materialize in these operations.

zh: 在不进行舰队作战的同时，第二分舰队的舰只也在易北河口巡逻，以支援轻型部队保卫德意志湾；它们还在相对安全的波罗的海进行了训练演习。
en: While there are no fleet operations, the vessels of the Second Fleet are patrolling only at the Ebei port to support the light forces in the defence of the German Gulf; they also conduct training exercises in the relatively safe Baltic Sea.

zh: 1915年2月，德国号成为第二分舰队旗舰。
en: In February 1915, the German fleet became the flagship of the Second Division.

zh: 6月6日，一股东风波离开非洲海岸。
en: On 6 June, a shareholder left the African coast.

zh: 系统在低纬度海域向西移动，其轴线上存在的扰动天气到6月9日时组织结构已有改善，考虑到此时飓风季尚未开始，系统的外境环境相对而言已很有利于热带气旋发展。
en: The system moved westward in the lower latitudes and the disturbance weather on its axis had improved its organizational structure by 9 June, taking into account that the hurricane season had not yet begun and that the external environment of the system had been relatively favourable to tropical cyclones.

zh: 系统起初没有层次分明的下层环流，6月10日，对流已有进一步增长，美国国家飓风中心于6月11日清晨宣布位于热带大西洋中部的气旋已成为第二号热带低气压，这也是有纪录以来第4个于6月在小安的列斯群岛以东发展形成的热带气旋，另外两个分别是2000年的第二号热带低气压，1979年的热带风暴安娜，以及1933年的第二号飓风。
en: The system initially did not have a structured lower circulation, and on 10 June, there was a further increase in the flow, with the United States National Hurricane Center declaring in the early morning hours of 11 June that cyclones located in the middle of the tropical Atlantic had become tropical depression II, the fourth tropical cyclone that had developed east of the Lesser Antilles in June, and two tropical depressions in 2000, tropical storm Anna in 1979 and hurricane II in 1933.

zh: 故事开始一位挪威退伍军人驾驶直升机在南极洲追杀一只雪橇犬并闯入美国的南极洲研究站。
en: The story began with a Norwegian war veterans helicopter chasing down a sled dog in Antarctica and breaking into the United States Antarctic research station.

zh: 这架直升机着陆后，退伍军人意外地将其炸毁并大喊挪威语，接着继续向跑入美国研究站的雪橇犬开枪，这一系列举动让在场围观的美方研究人员一头雾水。
en: When the helicopter landed, the veterans accidentally blew it up and shouted Norwegian, and continued to fire at sleigh dogs running into research stations in the United States, a series of actions that mistened the American researchers present.

zh: 追杀过程中挪威退伍军人打伤了一名研究人员，之后研究站主任加里找准时机在退伍军人接近研究站时开枪自卫将他击毙。
en: In the course of the pursuit, a Norwegian veteran was wounded by a researcher, who was later shot in self-defence by the director of the research station, Gary, when he approached the research station.

zh: 为了解情况美方直升机驾驶员麦克和科波医生前去挪威的基地调查，发现那里已烧成一片废墟，还有许多冰冻的尸体。
en: In order to obtain information, the American helicopter pilots Mike and Dr. Cobb went to their base in Norway to investigate the situation and found that the site was in ruins and that there were many frozen bodies.

zh: 两人还发现严重烧伤但仍然形似人体的畸形尸体，将之带回研究站，生物学家布莱尔的验尸结果表明尸体内有正常人体器官。
en: The two men also found severe burns, but still deformed bodies, and took them back to the research station, where the biologist Blair ' s autopsy revealed that there were normal human organs in the body.

zh: 内战爆发后，美国经济陷入泥潭，大部分硬币都从市场流通中消失，为填补市场需求，人们采用的替代手段包括商家代币、包裹邮资贴花和发行面额低至3美分的美国辅币。
en: Following the civil war, the United States economy became mired, and most of the coins disappeared from market flows. Alternatives used to meet market demand included commercial coins, parcel postage stickers and United States coins with a minimum of 3 cents in nominal terms.

zh: 除由黄金和白银这些贵金属铸造的硬币大多被人们囤积或是外流其他国家外，连仅有的贱金属硬币、铜镍合金制成的分币也从市场上消失了。
en: In addition to coins made of precious metals such as gold and silver, which are mostly hoarded or exported to other countries, even the only coins made of base metals and copper nickel alloys have disappeared from the market.

zh: 为恢复硬币流通，国会于1864年废除3美分辅币，授权制造铜质1美分和2美分硬币，并且这些硬币所包含的金属价值也低于其面值。
en: With a view to restoring the circulation of coins, Congress abolished 3 cents in 1864, authorizing the manufacture of 1 cents and 2 cents of copper coins, and the metals contained in these coins were also below their nominal value.

zh: 这些新币起初获得热烈反响，但2美分很快也从市场流通中消失。
en: These new currencies initially received a strong response, but two cents quickly disappeared from the market.

zh: 1865年3月3日，国会通过法案授权铸币局以75%的铜和25%的镍打造3美分硬币。
en: On 3 March 1865, Congress passed a bill authorizing the Castery Bureau to make three cents of the coin with 75 per cent copper and 25 per cent nickel.

zh: 竞选期间，汉纳的大部分时间都是在位于纽约的竞选总部度过，为此还在新泽西州蒙茅斯县的埃尔贝伦租了间海滨小屋住下。
en: During the campaign, Hanna spent most of her time at the New York-based campaign headquarters, where she also rented a beach house in El Belém, Monmouth County, New Jersey.

zh: 9月，美国煤矿工人联合会发起罢工，引起的危机可能会对麦金莱竞选连任构成不利影响。
en: In September, the United States Coal Mining Workers ' Federation launched a strike, and the resulting crisis could have a negative impact on McKinley ' s re-election campaign.

zh: 汉纳觉得事态不算严重，说服各方同意由他仲裁。
en: Hannah felt that the situation was not serious and persuaded the parties to agree to his arbitration.

zh: 在他的协助下，双方最终经谈判解决争端。
en: With his assistance, the parties eventually negotiated a settlement of the dispute.

zh: 接下来出场的是热带风暴何塞，于8月22日在坎佩切湾成形。
en: This was followed by tropical storm José, which took shape in Campeche Bay on 22 August.

zh: 气旋迅速强化，但很快就抵达海岸，于8月23日登陆韦拉克鲁斯州，所以无法继续增强。
en: The cyclone intensified rapidly, but soon reached the coast and landed in Veracruz on 23 August, making it impossible to continue.

zh: 韦拉克鲁斯州有2.5万人被迫撤离，瓦哈卡州有6人因风暴丧生，另外还有两人失踪。
en: In Veracruz, 25,000 people were forced to evacuate, six in Oaxaca were killed by the storm, and two others disappeared.

zh: 何塞一共在墨西哥引起价值4500万美元的破坏（2005年美元，相当于2026年的7418万美元）。
en: In total, José caused damage in Mexico worth $45 million (2005 dollars, equivalent to $7.418 million in 2026).

zh: 1980年代中期因东部干线旅客快速增长由DR2800型柴油动车组行驶的自强号列车经常一票难求，因此1985年11月开标购置5组15辆新型柴油动车组自强号，由日本日立制作所中标，型式编为DR2900型。
en: In the mid-1980s, as a result of the rapid growth of passengers on the main east line, the DR2800 diesel-powered self-propelled train was often hard to obtain, resulting in the opening of tenders in November 1985 for a group of 5 new groups of 15 diesel-powered self-propelled cars, which were awarded the DR2900 model by the Japanese Japanese Hithi.

zh: 1987年初已有三组抵达，最后两组于当年春节运输高峰前一天1月27日抵达台湾，最后抵台的列车在下船之后随即安装座椅与冷气空调，并且连夜于台北至新竹间进行进行试运行以及验收，在下船后的隔日立即投入春节运输加班车行驶。
en: Three groups arrived at the beginning of 1987 and the last two groups arrived in Taiwan on 27 January, the day before the peak of the spring season, and the train that finally arrived was immediately equipped with seating and air conditioning immediately after disembarkation, as well as a test operation and acceptance at Taipei to the new bamboo range overnight, immediately after disembarkation, to be used for the spring transport overtime.

zh: 风暴过去后，留尼汪共出现约1万5000起损失索赔，有3251套民宅受损，约850套被毁。
en: Following the storm, there were approximately 15,000 claims for damages in Réunion, 3,251 homes were damaged and approximately 850 destroyed.

en: To date, the black ball finals remain the most popular sports programme in British television history and the second highest in BBC history.

zh: 1960年代，南丰继续扩展业务，收购了邻近的地段共设立六个厂房，而纱厂的六厂、四厂及五厂分别在1961年、1962年与1970年落成。
en: In the 1960s, Nanfeng continued to expand its operations by acquiring six plants in adjacent areas, while the sixth, fourth and fifth plants of the yarn plant were inaugurated in 1961, 1962 and 1970 respectively.

zh: 时值香港制造业发展蓬勃的黄金年代，南丰纱厂为香港纺纱生产商龙头，著名于每年极高的生产量，高峰时期年产3000万磅棉纱，产量一度高居香港业界前列。
en: During the golden years of booming manufacturing in Hong Kong, the Nan Fong Gar factory was the leader of Hong Kong ' s silk-save producers, known for its very high annual production volume, which peaked at 30 million pounds a year, once at the top of the Hong Kong industry.

zh: 1971年，香港棉纺业的发展速度大大减缓，但南丰纱厂在当年却增设了3,056枚纱键和购入了9,598枚纱键，共增加12,656枚纱键，成为当年香港三十多家棉纺厂中十家增加纱键的棉纺厂之一；南丰纱厂的附属布厂在当年也增加288台布机。
en: In 1971, Hong Kong ' s cotton mill slowed considerably, but the Nanfung factory added 3,056 gauze keys and purchased 9,598 gauze keys, adding a total of 12,656 gauze keys, becoming one of the 10 gauze-added cotton mills in Hong Kong ' s 30 cotton mills in 1971; and the Nanfeng plant ' s annex added 288 bots in that year.

en: The history of the interplanetary earthquake near NASCAR has been running for 80 years.

zh: 1949年的安巴托地震是当时该国现代史上第二严重的地震，仅次于1797年里奥班巴地震，也是自1944年圣胡安地震后整个西半球最具灾难性的地震。
en: The Ambato earthquake of 1949 was the second most severe earthquake in the modern history of the country at that time, after the Rio Bamba earthquake of 1797, and the most catastrophic earthquake in the entire hemisphere since the San Juan earthquake of 1944.

zh: 自这场地震后，该国又发生了多次大地震，包括1987年厄瓜多尔地震和1997年厄瓜多尔地震。
en: Since the earthquake, the country has experienced several major earthquakes, including in Ecuador in 1987 and in Ecuador in 1997.

en: The major earthquake in Peru in 2007 also affected the country.

zh: 奥利弗打字机的整体设计自始至终基本保持一致，所有产品都是“下击式”打字机，即用户敲键时，各键是从上往下打到压盘上，而不是从下往上（“上击式”）或从前往后（“前击式”）。
en: The overall design of the Oliver typewriter was largely consistent from the beginning to the end, and all products were “down-click” typewriters, i.e., when the user knocked the keys from the top down to the compactor, rather than from the bottom up (“up-click”) or from the back.

zh: 与“上击式”相比，“下击式”属“可视打印”设计，操作员可以一边打字一边看到输出的字符。
en: Compared to the " upper click " , the " lower click " is a " visual printable " design, and the operator can type and see the characters of the output.

zh: “下击式”产生的冲击力也比较大，这令奥利弗打字机在版面模子和曲面打字（使用碳式复写纸）时效果更好，更有竞争力。
en: The impact of the “downlash” is also greater, making the Oliver typewriter more effective and competitive when typing on the layout and on the curve (using carbon double-written paper).

zh: “前击式”也是在1889至1891年间取得专利，同样支持可视打印，但却直到1897年时才有不会干扰打字员视线的安德伍德No.1型面世，比奥利弗No.1型要晚约三年。
en: The “foreword” was also patented between 1889 and 1891 and also supported visual printing, but it was not until 1897 that Underwood No. 1 was born without interference from typists, and the Bioliv No. 1 was about three years late.

zh: 秦朝政治另一个特色是连坐法。
en: Another feature of Qin Dynasty politics is the law of association.

zh: 对于各级官僚，当某处底层发生社会动荡等严重违反秦律的事情，则从最下级官员一直到中级官员全部撤职，只需要审判最底层的官员，定罪后则他的几层上级无须审判就可全部定罪。
en: In the case of bureaucrats at all levels, serious violations of Qin law, such as social unrest at the bottom of a given locality, are removed from office from the lowest level to the middle level, only to try the lowest level of official, and, upon conviction, all of his superiors can be convicted without trial.

zh: 在地方，则有什伍连坐法，按军事组织把全国吏民编制起来，将农户的住宅集中在田边联排建设，户户相邻，并以“五家为伍，十家为什”编为单元，便于互相监视，互相检举，每组单元均设立负责人，若单元内有人犯法或举报，负责人要向上级汇报并依法律处理。
en: At the local level, there is a Shiv association, organized by military organizations and organized throughout the country, which concentrates the homes of farmers on the side of the field, houses in the vicinity, and is made up of “five by five and ten by one”, which allows for mutual monitoring and reporting, with each unit having its own head, who will report the offence or report it to his superiors and will act in accordance with the law.

zh: 农户不准擅自迁居，不得私下斗殴，不留宿未登记之陌生人，不得私售粮食等等。
en: Farmers are not allowed to move without permission, to fight in private, to stay without a registered stranger, to sell food, etc.

zh: 这种严苛的法律把农民牢牢束缚在土地上，国家直接控制了全国的劳动力，极大提高粮食赋税收入。
en: This harsh law places farmers firmly on the land, and the State directly controls the country ' s labour force and significantly increases the revenue from food taxes.

zh: 1914年8月战争爆发后，海军参谋本部将第二分舰队部署至德意志湾，以保卫德国海岸免受德国人认为迫在眉睫的英国皇家海军大规模攻击。
en: Following the outbreak of the war in August 1914, the Navy Staff Headquarters deployed a second detachment to the Gulf of Deutsche to defend the German coast from what the Germans considered to be an imminent mass attack by the Royal Navy.

zh: 普鲁士号及其分舰队余部驻扎在易北河河口，对在海湾执行巡逻任务的舰艇提供支援。
en: The Prussia and the rest of its fleet are stationed at the estuary of the Elbe River to provide support to the vessels patrolling the Gulf.

zh: 当明确了英国人不会袭击公海舰队后，德国人便开始了一系列的行动，旨在引诱并歼灭在数量上占优势的英国大舰队的部分兵力。
en: When it became clear that the British would not attack the fleet on the high seas, the Germans began a series of operations aimed at inducing and destroying part of the British fleet, which was in a numerical position.

zh: 通过实现兵力的大致均等，帝国海军就可以在北海南部发动决定性的战役。
en: By achieving roughly equal numbers of troops, the Imperial Navy could launch a decisive battle in the south of the North Sea.

zh: 1939年10月4日，西南联大各学院集中至新校舍后开学。
en: On 4 October 1939, the schools of the South-West Assembly were assembled in new premises and opened.

zh: 西南联大时期，毕业生分南开、清华、北大、联大四类学籍，合并前学生拥有原校学籍，合并后招生为联大学籍。
en: At the time of the South-West Congress, graduates were enrolled in four categories: South, Qinghua, North China, and the General Assembly. Former students were integrated into their original studies, and subsequently into the United Nations University.

zh: 同年，南开大学经济研究所在重庆市沙坪坝的重庆南开中学图书馆内恢复成立，在昆明设办事处。
en: In the same year, the Institute of Economics of the University of Nankai was re-established in the Chongqing South High School Library at the Saffron Dam in Chongqing City, with an office in Kunming.

zh: 泰勒先单杆拿到50分，但戴维斯很快反超，在首阶段七局比赛大获全胜。
en: Taylor won 50 points on a single pole, but Davis quickly went backwards and won the first seven games.

zh: 第二阶段戴维斯拿下第一局，但第二局分数领先时薄绿球失手，赛后分析认为这是决赛的转折点，泰勒扳回一局，而且此后七局拿下六局，并以单杆98分创下决赛纪录，虽然还是落后，但比分已追到七比九。
en: In the second phase, Davis won the first round, but the second round lost a thin green ball in the lead, the post-election analysis considered it a turning point in the finals, Taylor pulled back to the finals, and since then, in the sevens, the finals were recorded at 98 on a single pole, but the score was seven to nine.

zh: 第二天泰勒虽然一直没能领先，但咬紧比分成11平和15平。
en: The next day, Taylor, although never leading, bited more than 11 and 15 square feet.

zh: 戴维斯再下两局，以17比15拿到赛点，但泰勒又在第33局以微弱优势取胜，第34局单杆打出57分追成17平，双方需在第35局一决雌雄。
en: The next two games of Davis, 17 to 15, were won by Taylor in the 33rd, with a weak edge, and the 34th round, with a 57-to- 17-square score, required by both sides in the 35th.

zh: 半美元背面主体是伸出手臂表示欢迎的自由女神，远方的背景包括林奇堡法院和部分纪念露台，法院前方是联盟国纪念碑。
en: The subject of half a dollar on the back is the Statue of Liberty, whose arms are extended and welcomed, and the distant background includes the Lynchburg Court and part of the memorial balcony, which is in front of the memorial to the Union State.

zh: 安东尼·斯沃泰克2012年的纪念币主题著作声称，“美利坚联盟国在这枚硬币上特别突出”。
en: Anthony Swotek's 2012 book on the theme of coins claimed that “the United States of America is particularly prominent in this coin”.

zh: 林奇堡这座纪念碑于1900年揭幕，同美国境内其他联盟国纪念碑一样存在争议，反对者认为应该把这类纪念物推倒，但截至2017年，该纪念碑依然屹立。
en: The memorial to Lynchburg, which was inaugurated in 1900, is as controversial as other memorials to the Union State in the United States, and which the opponents believe should be pushed down, was still standing until 2017.

zh: 与此同时，天津作为中国近代化工业的发源地，私立南开大学自创立以来陆续设立了化学系、化学工程系和应用化学研究所，抓住了天津化学工业快速发展的契机，奠定了该学科在全国的领先地位。
en: At the same time, Tianjin, the birthplace of the modern chemical industry in China, has since its inception established the Department of Chemistry, the Department of Chemical Engineering and the Institute of Applied Chemistry at the private Nanka University.

zh: 而北洋大学直至抗日战争爆发前夕，才开始酝酿建立相关学科的构想。
en: It was not until the eve of the war that the University of the North began to develop the idea of establishing the relevant disciplines.

zh: 不少随库克出海的皇家海军初级军官在日后也各有所成，曾经随库克出任航海长的威廉·布莱后来担任HMS邦蒂号舰长，并且是1789年邦蒂号叛变事件中被船员推翻的主角。
en: A number of junior officers of the Royal Navy who came to sea with Cook will also be successful in the future. William Blé, who served as sea captain with Cook, later served as Captain HMS Bunty and was the main cause of the overthrow by the crew of the Bounty in 1789.

zh: 布莱后于1806年出任新南威尔士总督，但在1808年再于兰姆酒叛乱中被起事军人推翻。
en: In 1806, he was appointed Governor of New South Wales, but in 1808, he was overthrown by the military.

zh: 曾在库克船队中任职候补海军少尉的乔治·温哥华则在1791年至1794年间奉命带领船队探索北美太平洋海岸地区，对勘察北美西北岸一带具重要贡献。
en: George Vancouver, who served as an alternate Navy Lieutenant in the Cook Fleet, was given a mandate from 1791 to 1794 to lead the fleet in the exploration of the North American Pacific coast, making an important contribution to the exploration of the north-west coast of North America.

zh: 至于曾经参与库克第三次航海旅程的乔治·迪克森，日后也组织了自己的探索队到太平洋地区。
en: As for George Dixon, who had been involved in Cook's third voyage, he had later organized his own expedition to the Pacific.

zh: 居住在该区域的数百万人感觉到了这次地震，这也是数十年来的首次重大地震事件。
en: The earthquake was felt by millions of people living in the region, the first major earthquake in decades.

zh: 震颤之后，该地区的企业被清空。
en: After the tremors, businesses in the area were emptied.

zh: 许多居民不相信地震震级超过了5级，有些人还没反应过来刚才发生了地震，比如有些居民就以为他们的炉子爆炸了，还有一个人以为震动是因自己的儿子“上窜下跳”导致的。
en: Many residents did not believe that the earthquake was above level 5 and some had not responded to the earthquake earlier, such as those who thought that their stove had exploded and others that the shock had been caused by their son's “up and down”.

zh: 在距震中48千米麦克莱恩斯伯勒的一家工厂，工人们冲出厂房，以为里面一个容量为4200升的水缸掉下来了。
en: At a factory at MacLeansboro, 48 km from the epicenter, the workers ran out of the plant and thought that a cylinder with a capacity of 4,200 litres had fallen.

zh: 朱利安·西蒙斯在《泰晤士报文学增刊》发文，对《太空城》感到失望，批评作者“恶搞惊悚体裁……的倾向在小说后半部喧宾夺主”。
en: Julian Simmons, in an article published in the Times Literature Supplement, was disappointed by Space City and criticized the author for “the tendency to be the one in the second half of the novel”.

zh: 《观察家报》刊登莫里斯·理查森的评论，敦促读者“切勿错过”，称“虽有些难以置信，但弗莱明先生（的小说）依然好看到令人无法抗拒”。
en: The observer newspaper published Maurice Richardson's comments urging readers to “do not miss” and stating that “Mr. Flemming (novel) is unresistible despite some implausibility”.

zh: 《听众》杂志的希拉里·科克赞扬“弗莱明是极具成就的惊悚小说家”，《太空城》就像作者的其他作品一样“好看到令人无话可说”。
en: Hillary Kirk of The Audience praised “Flamingy as a very successful novelist” and “good to see nothing to say” like the author's other works.

zh: 他还告诫弗莱明立足现实，不要过分戏剧化，称：“弗莱明先生显然已经太有成就，根本不需要依靠那些充满混乱和流血的噱头：他能让我们专心看完三百页，书中不用多流一滴血（指不用任何噱头），完全符合《威尼斯商人》中律师向犹太商人夏洛克提出的要求”。
en: He also cautioned Flemming against being too dramatic, saying: “It is clear that Mr. Flemming has achieved too much and that he does not need to rely on the shrouds of chaos and bloodshed: He was able to focus our attention on 300 pages, without a drop of blood in the book (meaning nothing) and in full compliance with the request made by the lawyers in the Venice Businessman to Sherlock, a Jewish businessman”.

zh: 《苏格兰人报》发文称赞作者对紧张刺激情节的处理得心应手，令人惊叹不已。
en: The Scottish newspaper wrote an amazing praise for the author ' s responsiveness to stress stimuli.

zh: 地震预警技术是指在地震发生后、而未及造成严重破坏前，通过无线电向外界发布警报的技术。
en: Seismic warning technologies are those used to send warnings to the outside world by radio after an earthquake and before causing serious damage.

zh: 地震预警系统必须首先侦测确定一个破坏性的地震后才能发布有用的地震预警信息。
en: Earthquake early warning systems must first detect a devastating earthquake before they can release useful earthquake early warning information.

zh: 地震发震后，具破坏性的S波（每秒3.2至4千米）传播速度较慢，而由于电磁波比地震波快，系统可以把监测设备观测到的P波（每秒5.5至7千米）信息转为电磁波，在地震波到达前数秒甚至几十秒发出预警。
en: After an earthquake earthquake, destructive S waves (3.2 to 4 km/s) spread at a slower rate, and because electromagnetic waves are faster than seismic waves, the system can convert the P-wave information observed by the monitoring equipment (5.5 to 7 km/s) to electromagnetic waves, providing early warning in seconds or even dozens of seconds before the wave reaches.

zh: 气旋乔伊在距昆士兰州近海的绿岛不到80公里海域经过，产生的阵风时速达180公里；另外多个岛受到严重破坏，麦凯有一人在冲浪时溺亡。
en: Cyclone Joy passed less than 80 kilometres off Green Island in Queensland, generating winds of up to 180 kilometres per hour; several other islands were severely damaged and one man drowned while surfing.

zh: 风暴期间有一艘船失去动力，船上4人被困在科克茅斯岛达4天之久，幸运的是他们随后都获直升机救援。
en: One vessel lost power during the storm, and four people were trapped on Cokermouth Island for four days, and fortunately they were subsequently rescued by helicopters.

zh: 惠森迪岛有许多船只受损。
en: Many ships were damaged in Whesende Island.

zh: 威斯敏斯特站位于英国伦敦威斯敏斯特市，是伦敦地铁环线、区域线及银禧线会让的地铁站。
en: Westminster Station is located in Westminster City, London, the London metro ring, the regional line and the silver jubilee.

zh: 本站设在桥街及维多利亚堤道的路口、泰晤士河西岸，与英国国会附楼——保达德利大厦共构，附近有威斯敏斯特宫（国会厅舍）、威斯敏斯特修道院、国会广场、威斯敏斯特桥、伦敦眼、白厅等景点，离唐宁街、财政部、外交部、威斯敏斯特千禧码头、最高法院、战争纪念碑及朝鲜战争纪念碑亦不远。
en: The station is located at the intersection of Bridge Street and Victoria dyke, West Bank of the Thames River, in conjunction with the House of Boddredley, an annex to the British Parliament, near the Westminster Palace (the House of Congress), the Westminster Monastery, Congress Square, Westminster Bridge, London Eye, Whitehall, etc., and is not far from Downing Street, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Westminster Millennium Pier, the Supreme Court, the War Memorial and the Korean War Monument.

zh: 协调世界时1月17日凌晨0点，法国气象局将热带扰动升级成热带低气压，并在6小时后进一步将系统升级成热带风暴迪娜。
en: At 0:00 UTC, the French Meteorological Service upgraded tropical disturbances to tropical depression and, six hours later, to tropical storm Dina.

zh: 此后不久，联合台风警报中心发布热带气旋形成警报，并于当天开始针对迪戈加西亚岛以南约425公里洋面的气旋发布公告。
en: Shortly thereafter, the Joint Typhoon Alert Centre issued a tropical cyclone warning and, on the same day, began to issue a bulletin on cyclones some 425 kilometres south of Diego Garcia.

zh: 风暴迅速增强，发展期间经德沃夏克分析法得出的T数值每6小时就提高了0.5。
en: The storm surged rapidly, with T values derived from the Dvoschak analysis during the development period increasing by 0.5 per hour.

zh: 1月17日晚，迪娜开始发展出风眼，法国气象局于UTC1月18日中午12点将之升级成热带气旋，其强度与萨菲尔-辛普森飓风等级下的一级飓风相当。
en: On the evening of 17 January, Dina began to develop, and the French Meteorological Service escalated it into a tropical cyclone at 12 noon on 18 January, with the same intensity as a first-degree hurricane under Hurricane Safer-Simpson.

zh: 这时距系统首次归类为热带扰动还只过了36小时，与之相比，西南印度洋的大部分热带气旋都要花5天时间才能有如此幅度的增强。
en: This is only 36 hours after the system was first classified as tropical disturbance, compared to five days for most of the tropical cyclones in the south-west Indian Ocean to increase so significantly.

zh: 此外，联合台风警报中心也于3小时前将迪娜升级成热带气旋。
en: In addition, the Joint Typhoon Warning Centre upgraded Dina to tropical cyclone three hours ago.

zh: 大地震前发生了一次前震，虽然强度不大，但已经足以造成混乱并迫使人们走出家门到达大街上。
en: A major pre-earthquake, albeit modest in intensity, was sufficient to cause chaos and force people out of their homes to reach the streets.

zh: 主震源于安巴托东南部，其冲击安巴托时，这里的主教堂和城市内的大部分建筑物都坍塌了。
en: The main earthquake, which originated in south-east Ambato, collapsed in the main church and most of the buildings in the city when it hit Ambato.

zh: 多名准备在这座教堂接受她们首次洗礼的年轻女孩因此丧生。
en: Many young girls who were prepared to be baptized for their first time in this church were killed.

zh: 震动破坏了供水系统，通讯线路也被中断，地面开裂，桥梁变成一片废墟，还造成了一列火车脱轨。
en: The vibrations damaged the water supply system, the lines of communication were also disrupted, the ground was broken, the bridge was destroyed and a train derailed.

zh: 地震将乡下村镇的房子夷平，最接近安第斯山脉附近地区发生的山体滑坡摧毁了道路并阻塞了河流，附近一个名叫利伯塔德的村庄及其100位村民全部被一个直径800米的大洞吞没，下沉了460米。
en: The earthquake razed houses in villages and towns in the countryside, destroying roads and blocking rivers by landslides that were closest to the Andes, where a village called Libertad and its 100 inhabitants were all swallowed up by a hole 800 metres in diameter and sank 460 metres.

zh: 远至基多和瓜亚基尔地区的地震烈度仍然有IV。
en: The intensity of earthquakes in the regions of Quito and Guayaquil remains at IV.

zh: 风暴尚在发展期间时产生的强风就导致弗吉尼亚州里士满至少有5万电力用户失去供电。
en: At least 50,000 electricity users in Richmond, Virginia, have lost electricity as a result of strong winds during the storm.

en: Many trees were uprooted by the wind in Karol district.

zh: 东北风暴的南部边缘存在强烈的雷暴活动，佛罗里达州昆西有一场龙卷风着陆，袭击了一个工业区，掀开至少三幢建筑物的屋顶，造成了10万美元（1969年美元，相当于87.8万2026年美元）的破坏。
en: There was intense thunderstorm activity on the southern edge of the north-east storm, with a tornado landing in Quincy, Florida, which attacked an industrial zone and opened the roofs of at least three buildings, causing damage of $100,000 (1969 dollars, equivalent to $878,026 dollars).

zh: 美国东北海岸沿线有多个主要机场因风暴被迫封闭，其中包括波士顿的爱德华·劳伦斯·洛根将军国际机场和纽约的拉瓜地亚机场。
en: A number of major airports along the north-eastern coast of the United States have been closed by storm, including General Edward Lawrence Logan International Airport in Boston and LaGuardia Airport in New York.

zh: 马绍尔群岛最先受到台风柏加的冲击，当地降下暴雨，经济损失达8000万美元。
en: The Marshall Islands was the first to be hit by Typhoon Burga, which caused heavy rainfall and economic damage of $80 million.

zh: 柏加之后从关岛以北经过，狂风摧毁当地约1500幢建筑物，另有约1万套受损，导致5000人无家可归，风暴过后全岛停电，损失数额达5亿美元，气旋名称“柏加”因此除名。
en: After passing north of Guam, the storm destroyed about 1,500 local buildings and damaged about 10,000 others, leaving 5,000 people homeless, causing electricity outages throughout the island in the aftermath of the storm, resulting in a loss of $500 million and the removal of the name of cyclone “Burga”.

zh: 此外，这场台风还在北马里亚纳群岛引起轻度破坏，但与其他地区一样，没有报道表明柏加引致伤亡。
en: In addition, the typhoon caused minor damage to the Northern Mariana Islands, but, as elsewhere, there were no reports of casualties in Burga.

en: Then Edith landed in the middle of the area where the warning was received.

en: Later that day, Cindy had begun to move northward, and Puerto Rico ' s observation warning had been upgraded to tropical storm warning.

zh: 政府向岛上部分地区发布了山洪爆发警告，约600位居住在洪水易发地区的居民在风暴来袭时离开家园寻求庇护。
en: The Government issued flash flood warnings to parts of the island, and some 600 residents living in flood-prone areas left their homes to seek refuge in the event of a storm.

en: The ferry service between Farhado and the offshore islands of Culebra and Vieques was suspended, with some 400 passengers trapped on the island for one day.

He returned to the flea market in anger, pretending to be the police and handcuffed, and then took the girl in a car to Kanova County, pretending to question her.

en: In exchanges, conflicts of thought, ethnic disputes and political struggles often result in destruction, massacres, etc.

In the case of Zhang Wei, the Han people had been ordered to kill the Qin, killing more than 200,000 people and killing the Qin people. When Ishi Zhao was killed, the people and the nomadic people returned to their places of origin and attacked each other on their way to and from their places of origin, together with a shortage of food, less than three-tenths of the time they were able to return home.

en: This fault is aligned with the east-west direction and connects to the east end of the earthquake belt in the Wabash Valley, heading north-south.

en: The results of the seismic mapping done by geologists showed a single slope, a back slope and a slope, which meant that the slide faults that had occurred in the vicinity of the ancient era had led to a physical transformation.

en: This fault runs along an ancient, former cold-blooded landscape and remains active mainly in the end of Pennsylvania and the early stages of the Second Era some 300 million years ago.

zh: 普鲁士号出席了1914年于5月2日在森讷堡举行的庆祝普丹战争迪伯尔战役胜利50周年的纪念活动；与它同行的还有姊妹舰黑森号、洛林号、战列舰西里西亚号以及大巡洋舰布吕歇尔号。
en: The Prussia attended the commemoration of the fiftieth anniversary of the victory in the battle of Dibor of the Pudan War, which was held in Sunnaburg on 2 May 1914; it was accompanied by the sister ships Hessen, Lorraine, Silesia and Bruscher.

zh: 7月，普鲁士号参与了前往挪威的舰队巡航，但这次巡航受到奥匈大公弗朗茨·斐迪南遇刺而引发的七月危机以及随后国际紧张局势加剧的影响而中断。
en: In July, the Prussia was involved in a fleet cruise to Norway, which was interrupted by the July crisis triggered by the assassination of Grand Duke Franz Ferdinand of Austria and the subsequent increase in international tensions.

zh: 7月25日，船员们获悉奥匈帝国向塞尔维亚发出最后通牒，普鲁士号遂于翌日离开挪威与舰队余部会合。
en: On 25 July, the crew learned of an ultimatum from the Austrian Hungarian Empire to Serbia, and the Prussia left Norway the following day to join the rest of the fleet.

zh: 该舰原定于同年年底退役，其分舰队旗舰的职责将由无畏舰威斯特法伦号取代。
en: The ship was due to be decommissioned at the end of the same year, and the duties of its fleet of flagships would be replaced by those of the Dauntless Westfarun.

zh: 普鲁士号原计划还将接替维特尔斯巴赫号进入波罗的海预备役支队，但第一次世界大战的爆发使这些计划全部打消。
en: The original plan for the Prussia to take over from the Vitelsbach into the Baltic Reserves was completely eliminated by the outbreak of the First World War.

zh: 尼克松的朋友理查德·摩尔告诉了演讲撰稿人威廉·萨菲尔自己看到了这么个标语，他当时下了火车走入人群中，希望可以为演讲撰稿人找到一些有用的，带有地方色彩的内容。
en: Nixon's friend Richard Moore told the author of the speech, William Safir, himself, that he had seen a sign that he had taken off the train and walked into the crowd in the hope that he would find useful, local content for the author.

zh: 萨菲尔之后在自己所著的书中（于尼克松担任总统早期撰写，1975年出版）表示，“摩尔（在德什勒）登上火车时，脸上带着那种神秘的表情，就是那种当一个作家想到一个绝妙的点子来写时的表情，而且远远不止是一个噱头那么简单”。
en: Safir then wrote in his book (in the early days of Nixon's presidency, published in 1975) that “Moor (in Deschler) boarded the train with that mysterious look on his face, the look when a writer came up with a brilliant idea, and it was far more than just a twilight”.

zh: 据萨菲尔在2007年的一篇专栏文章中所说，摩尔把头探到尼克松演讲撰稿人们所在的车厢中说：“外面有个孩子举着个手写的标语牌，我想那上面写的是‘让我们团结起来’。”
en: According to a 2007 column article by Saphael, Moor looked his head in the trunk of Nixon's speechwriters and said, "There's a kid out there with a handwritten sign, and I think it says, "Let's unite."

zh: 萨菲尔还在文章中称，自己在尼克松到达下一站发表的演说词里就增加了这句短语。
en: In his article, Safir also stated that he had added this phrase to his speech at Nixon's next stop.

zh: 9月1至2日，墨西哥湾沿岸多家企业向佛罗里达电力公司求助，请该公司帮助恢复17万客户的电力供应。
en: From 1 to 2 September, a number of enterprises along the Gulf of Mexico approached the Florida Electricity Company for help in restoring the electricity supply to 170,000 clients.

zh: 到了9月4日，除圣乔治岛外其它所有地区的供电都已恢复，该岛则预计还需再过几天才能恢复。
en: By 4 September, electricity had been restored in all areas except St. George's Island, which is expected to be restored in a few days.

zh: 佛罗里达州在风暴过后不到一个月就颁布了新的沿海建筑法规，因此房屋严重受损的业主在重建家园时必须根据新的建筑标准施工。
en: In Florida, new coastal building codes were enacted less than a month after the storm, so that owners of severely damaged houses had to work according to new building standards when rebuilding their homes.

zh: 新的规定要求住建部门在批准损毁建筑重建前，需要对房屋之前的历史情况以及周边的建筑物进行更加充分和严格的研究审查。
en: The new regulations require a fuller and more rigorous review of the historical situation prior to the destruction and reconstruction of the building, as well as the surrounding buildings, before the building is approved.

zh: 州长格雷厄姆起初还曾建议损毁程度超过一半的房屋先不要重建。
en: Governor Graham had also initially advised that houses with more than half the damage should not be rebuilt.

zh: 飓风艾琳娜过境数年后，恢复工作仍然在小范围进行，例如皮内拉斯县印度岩石海滩的沙滩补充工作就是从1990年夏季开始。
en: Several years after Hurricane Elena crossed the border, recovery efforts are still on a small scale, as in the case of the beach supplement in Indian rock beaches in Pineras County, starting in the summer of 1990.

zh: 原来的维多利亚十字勋章于1856年由维多利亚女王设立，旨在奖励英勇行为，与是否长期服役或有立功表现无关。
en: The original Victoria Cross Order was established by Queen Victoria in 1856 to reward heroic behaviour, regardless of whether it is a long service or a performance.

zh: 她于1856年1月29日签署王家认证，正式设立了这一奖项。
en: She signed the Royal Certificate on 29 January 1856 and formally established the award.

zh: 勋章追溯奖励了1854年克里米亚战争中的英勇行为。
en: The Medal retroactively rewarded the heroic acts of the Crimea War of 1854.

zh: 贝尔斯福德以仔细为自己电影的每一个镜头做计划而闻名，他亲自绘制了故事画板，并详细绘出自己对镜头的设想。
en: Belsford is famous for carefully planning every shot of his film, drawing storyboards and drawing his own vision of the camera.

zh: 珍妮·克劳迪亚·欧普瓦获聘出任艺术指导，导演称赞她“绝对精彩”，特别是对一些非常微小细节的关注，“从窗帘到地板上被子的颜色”。
en: Jenny Claudia Opua was hired as an art director and the director praised her for “absolutely wonderful”, especially for her attention to some very small detail, “the colour of the covers from the curtain to the floor”.

zh: 汽车旅馆的名字“Mariposa”也是欧普瓦起的，这个词在西班牙语中是蝴蝶的意思，象征着男主角将在这里体验到精神上的复活。
en: The name of the motel, Mariposa, also came from Opwar, which means butterflies in Spanish and symbolizes the spiritual revival that the leading man will experience here.

zh: 导演选择了澳大利亚的拉塞尔·波伊德出任摄影师，又请来曾在自己之前的每一部电影中合作过的爱尔兰剪辑师威廉·M·安德森，还选择了伊丽莎白·麦克布莱曼担任服装设计师，这也是她首次在电影中担当这一职务，之后她也以给德克萨斯或其他南方人物角色设计服装而闻名。
en: The director chose Russell Boyd of Australia as a photographer and invited William M. Anderson, an Irish editor who had worked with him in each of his previous films, and Elizabeth McBrideman as a costume designer for the first time in a film, after which she was known for designing costumes for Texas or other Southern characters.

zh: 3月10日，官方网站公布了名为“New-TurnProject”的复出活动，以宣传即将发行的回归新曲。
en: On 10 March, the official website published a re-emergence event entitled “New-TurnProject” to promote the upcoming re-enactment.

zh: 官方网站中的虚拟樱花树随着回归的时间渐近，樱花便绽放得愈茂盛。
en: The virtual cherry trees on the official website are growing as the time comes to return.

zh: 而歌迷只要在3月10日至4月30日期间于推特上以关键字“#欢迎回来HIKKI”发文或者在线上平台购买宇多田的作品的话，当中的实际收益会被部分捐助给修复受海啸破坏的樱花树的慈善团体，以进行植树活动。
en: The real proceeds of the song will be partially donated to the charity for the rehabilitation of the tsunami-damaged cherry trees for tree planting if the fans write on Twitter “#Welcome back to HIKKI” or buy Doda's work on the online platform from March 10 to April 30.

zh: 同时，音乐流媒体网站GYAO!及USEN亦会加入相关捐款活动，以点阅率来决定捐款数目。
en: At the same time, the music stream media website SYAO! and USEN are also participating in a donation event to determine the number of donations by means of a call.

zh: 活动最后获得超过3万个庆祝推文，官方网站的虚拟樱花树亦在活动完结前完全绽放。
en: The event culminated in over 30,000 commemorative tweets and the virtual cherry trees of the official website were fully developed before the event was completed.

zh: 而活动所筹得的善款其后被用作于2017年3月11日东日本大震灾6周年纪念日所进行的植树活动。
en: The funds raised by the event were subsequently used for tree planting on 11 March 2017, the sixth anniversary of the Great Earthquake in East Japan.

zh: 作为副州长，柯林斯还有主持州参议院运作的义务。
en: As Deputy Governor, Collins also has the obligation to preside over the State Senate.

zh: 两大主要党派的参议员都称赞了她在议事程序上表现出的公正和学识。
en: The senators of the two major parties praised her for her impartiality and knowledge in the proceedings.

zh: 她任内一共出现了两次投票出现半数对半数僵局，需要她投下决定票的情况，其中一项法案是允许该州的教师参与集体协商，另一项法案则是允许州内的银行跨越县界设立分行，这两次她都投下了反对票，令法案不能通过。
en: On two occasions, she had had to vote for a half-to-half deadlock, requiring her to vote for a decision, one of which was to allow teachers in the State to participate in collective consultations and the other to allow banks in the State to set up branches across the county border, both of which she had voted against and prevented the bill from being passed.

zh: 她任内还曾担任全美副州长会议主席，成为担任这一职位的首位女性。
en: She also served as President of the All-American Deputy Governor's Conference and was the first woman to hold that position.

zh: 1982年，她还成为美南浸信会神学院在路易维尔的校董会成员。
en: In 1982, she also became a member of the Board of Directors of the Southern Baptist Seminary in Louisville.

zh: 6月18日，科克伦告知众议院，两院已各自通过不同法案授权发行纪念币庆祝湾区新桥落成，建议众议院审议参议院通过的版本。
en: On 18 June, Koklen informed the Chamber of Deputies that the two houses had each passed separate bills authorizing the issuance of commemorative coins to celebrate the inauguration of the new bridge in the Bay area, recommending that the Chamber of Deputies consider the version adopted by the Senate.
