en: The Senate Bill was eventually passed by the Chamber of Deputies without any questions from members and the original bill passed by the Chamber of Deputies was put on hold.

zh: 1936年6月26日，经富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福总统签字，授权发行二十万枚半美元纪念币庆祝海湾大桥建成的法案成为法律正式生效。
en: On 26 June 1936, the bill authorizing the release of 200,000 half-dollars to celebrate the construction of the Gulf Bridge, signed by President Franklin Delano Roosevelt, entered into force.

zh: 此外，国会还曾审核建议发行纪念币庆祝金门大桥落成的法案，但最终没有通过。
en: In addition, the bill recommending the issuance of commemorative coins to celebrate the inauguration of the Golden Gate Bridge was reviewed by Congress, but ultimately not passed.

zh: 1928年，孙殿英所部曾经对定陵尝试盗掘，但在向地宫方向挖掘数米后停止，具体原因不明。
en: In 1928, Sun Temple Young tried to steal the mausoleum, but stopped a few metres in the direction of the palace for unknown reasons.

en: In September 1945, a group of bandits, such as Wang Shaoyi, who had used their homemade “knock keys” and explosives, had spent several days entering the palace, breaking apart the coffins of the salty Emperor and his Queen Sachda, and looting the funeral.

zh: 美国国家飓风中心将系统归类成潜在热带气旋后马上向除安德罗斯岛外的巴哈马西北地区发布热带风暴警告。
en: The National Hurricane Center of the United States classified the system as a potential tropical cyclone and issued tropical storm warnings to the north-west part of the Bahamas, with the exception of Andros.

zh: UTC9月13日凌晨三点，朱庇特至福禄喜雅县–布里瓦德县之间的佛罗里达狭地东海岸地区收到热带风暴观察预警，之后生效范围又向北面扩张，直至次日清晨中止。
en: On 13 September, at 3 a.m., a tropical storm observation warning was received on the eastern coast of the narrow Florida coast between the districts of Jupiter and Foroa-Brivad, and then extended northward until the following morning.

zh: 艾森豪威尔的反对意见主要认为授权之门一旦打开，各种纪念币就会接踵而至，为伪造大开方便之门。
en: Eisenhower's dissenting opinion is that once the door to authorization has been opened, the various commemorative coins will follow and open the door to forgery.

zh: 总统否决三项法案后，国会没有尝试推翻，美国此后四分之一个世纪没有发行纪念币，直到1981年财政部改变立场，但从此美国纪念币也不再由民间组织发行，改为政府销售。
en: After the President vetoed the three bills, Congress did not attempt to overturn them, and the United States did not issue a commemorative coin for a quarter of a century after that, until the Treasury changed its position in 1981, when the United States commemorative coin was no longer issued by civil society organizations for government sale.

zh: 心理学家吉尔伯特·雷耶斯和杰拉德·雅各布斯认为，《饿死鬼叭噗》是流行文化中发声批评人道主义的代表作品，这种批评指称人道主义事业经常夸大其辞，靠榨取他人的痛苦获利，对那些本来要帮助的人反而会造成伤害。
en: Psychologists Gilbert Reyes and Gerald Jacobs have argued that the death of the ghost of hunger is the work of a representative of popular culture who criticizes humanitarianism, alleging that humanitarian causes often exaggerate and profit from the suffering of others, to the detriment of those who would otherwise have helped.

zh: 还有评论中称，本集凸显了美国的消费主义社会特点，以及美国人对贫穷国家的冷漠。
en: It was also stated that the volume highlighted the social characteristics of consumerism in the United States and American indifference to poor countries.

zh: 斯坦在本集的最后一幕中道出节目的寓意，鼓励观众把贫穷国家中正在受苦的居民看作真实的人，而不只是电视荧屏上的图像，如果只看到这些图像，观众往往只会感到超脱和疏远。
en: In the final act of this episode, Stan shows the meaning of the programme, encouraging viewers to view the suffering inhabitants of poor countries as real people, not just images on television screens, which, if seen alone, tend to lead the audience to overstretched and alienated.

zh: 1925年2月4日，卡维尔在联邦众议院提出法案，建议发行挪威裔美国人勋章。
en: On 4 February 1925, Carver introduced a bill in the Federal House of Representatives recommending the issuance of the Norwegian American Order.

zh: 法案首先交于铸币和度量衡委员会审议。
en: The bill is first considered by the commission of foundries and measures.

zh: 2月10日，卡维尔代表该委员会向众议院报告，赞同发行纪念勋章。
en: On 10 February, on behalf of the Commission, Carver reported to the Chamber of Deputies, endorsing the issuance of the Medal of Remembrance.

zh: 卡维尔在报告中表示，授权发行的4万枚勋章不会耗费政府一分一毫，财政部官员也支持这项法案。
en: In its report, Carville stated that the 40,000 medals authorized would not cost the Government a penny, and that the bill was supported by officials of the Ministry of Finance.

zh: “鉴于是次庆典对本国众多挪威移民后裔的重要性，以及对那些身在明尼苏达州、正式赞助此次盛会的人们，和那些身在大西北、在国家发展中发挥如此巨大作用的人们的重要性，本委员会相信，发行这种勋章是正当而合适的，这项法案应当制定成法律。”
en: “In view of the importance of this celebration to the many descendants of Norwegian immigrants in the country, as well as to those in Minnesota, who officially sponsored it, and those who played such a significant role in the development of the country in the Great North-West, the Committee believes that the issuance of such decorations is justified and appropriate and that the bill should be enacted into law.”

zh: iPS细胞亦可以应用于新药开发中。
en: IPS cells can also be used in the development of new medicines.

zh: 比如，可以用iPS细胞在体外分化出成体细胞，再用药物处理分化的成体细胞，用以预测这些药物在实际应用到体内后是否会令使用者产生不良反应。
en: For example, iPS cells can be used to separate adult cells in vitro, and then to treat divided adult cells with drugs to predict whether these drugs will cause adverse effects to the user after they are actually applied in the body.

zh: 此外，亦可以使用iPS细胞进行疾病模型的构建。
en: In addition, iPS cells can be used to model disease.

zh: 即用病人的iPS细胞构建状态异常的成体细胞或组织。
en: That is, a form cell or tissue that constructs an abnormal state of the patient ' s iPS cell.

zh: 这样的成体细胞或组织可用作相关疾病的研究模型。
en: Such adult cells or tissues can be used as research models for related diseases.

zh: 目前，研究人员有计划用iPS细胞建立一个疾病模型库。
en: Currently, researchers have plans to build a model database of diseases using iPS cells.

zh: 除了陵区的主要建筑，在部分陵的风水墙外还有清代兵部和礼部的守陵官兵的营房，分别是昭西陵营房、孝陵营房、孝东陵营房、景陵营房、裕陵营房、定陵营房、旧太后陵（菩陀峪定东陵）营房、新太后陵（普祥峪定东陵）营房、惠陵营房，合称九营。
en: In addition to the main buildings in the mausoleums, there are also barracks for the troops of the Qingbai and Qiang provinces in some of the mausoleums. en: The relief component, with volunteers from the Tzu Chi Foundation in the south-central region working on disaster prevention, launched the Disaster Prevention Coordination Centre on the morning of 24 August to distribute supplies and provide hot food assistance to the victims.

en: The passage of Kate from south-west of Key West brought to the area a wind of up to 76 km per hour, with unofficial data on winds as high as 167 km per hour.

en: Rainfall in the south-west of Florida totalled around 25 mm, although it reached 53 mm in Key West.

en: The strong winds destroyed many trees and severed several power lines, resulting in power cuts between Kivist and Grand San Cay in Monroe County.

en: A mobile house was burned by a fire caused by electrical failure and one person died of electrocution.

en: The Florida Cays are characterized by mild flooding and coastal erosion due to tides above normal water levels.

zh: 下群岛海域有两人因船只倾覆遇难。
en: Two people were killed in the waters of the Lower Islands as a result of the wreckage.

en: Although only one vote was cast in 1964, McCain, upon his return, considered political participation.

en: In 1976, he once considered running for the Florida Federal House of Representatives, supported by local celebrities in Jacksonville, but other Republican leaders persuaded McCain to replace Charles Bennett, a Democrat who had held that position for many years, with insufficient political experience, funding and popular support.

zh: 1976年总统大选共和党初选期间，麦凯恩竭力协助罗纳德·里根，以致基地司令官批评他政治上过分积极，与他在海军的地位不相称。
en: During the presidential elections of 1976, during the Republican primaries, McCain tried so hard to assist Ronald Reagan that the Al-Qaida commander criticized him for being too politically active and disproportionate to his position in the Navy.

zh: 野牛镍币于1913年3月4日正式开始进入流通，很快就因真实描绘美国主题元素而获得赞誉。
en: The buffalo nickel was officially introduced into circulation on 4 March 1913 and soon received praise for the true depiction of American subject matter elements.

en: But the editorial of The New York Times argues that, from the point of view of coins that will circulate widely, the colour and glossiness of the new version of nickel do not seem to be ideal, and that it is easy to become old and dissatisfied.

en: In March and May of the same year, the Moneyologist published editorials evaluating the new currency in a warm manner, suggesting that the positive Indian head look be reduced and that the back buffalo be removed.

zh: 战争结束后，兰德尔坚定反对共和党人提出的大部分战后措施。
en: After the war, Randall firmly rejected most of the post-war measures proposed by Republicans.

zh: 1865年，共和党人提出旨在废除奴隶制的第十三条宪法修正案，兰德尔发言表示反对。
en: In 1865, the Republicans proposed a constitutional amendment to article 13 aimed at abolishing slavery, and Randall spoke against it.

zh: 兰德尔表示，他也反对奴隶制，但他还是反对这条修正案，因为这是“改变宪法和篡权的开始”。
en: Randall stated that he was also opposed to slavery, but he nevertheless opposed the amendment because it was “the beginning of constitutional change and usurpation”.

zh: 林肯总统遇刺后，安德鲁·约翰逊继任总统职位，兰德尔支持新总统重建战败南方的政策，因为这些政策同国会中共和党多数的提议相比更为温和。
en: After the assassination of President Lincoln, Andrew Johnson succeeded, and Randall supported the new President ' s policies to rebuild the defeated South, which were more moderate than the proposals of the Republican majority in Congress.

zh: 1867年，共和党议员要求南方所有期望投票、出任公职，或是在联邦法院出庭从事法律业务的人用绝对忠诚誓词宣誓，承诺他们永远都不会拿起武器对抗联邦。
en: In 1867, Republican parliamentarians asked all those in the south who expected to vote, to be elected to public office, or to appear before the Federal Court to swear by an absolute oath of loyalty that they would never take up arms against the Federation.

zh: 兰德尔发起长达16小时的冗长辩论阻止提案通过，但最终还是功败垂成。
en: Randall initiated a 16-hour lengthy debate that prevented the proposal from being adopted, but ultimately failed.

zh: SOLRAD/GRAB卫星一号采用实时通信，这也意味着只有卫星信号范围内有追踪站时才能传送数据，这些追踪站除前锋计划的迷你追踪站外还有为数不多的几处。
en: SOLRAD/GRAB-1 uses real-time communications, which also means that data can be transmitted only if there are tracking stations within the satellite signal range, which have a small number of stations in addition to the mini-tracking stations planned for the vanguard.

zh: 这导致卫星每绕地球一圈地面接收太阳观测数据的时间只有一到十分钟不等，仅占卫星活动时间的1.2%。
en: This results in satellites receiving solar observation data for only one to ten minutes per circle of Earth, only 1.2 per cent of satellite activity time.

zh: 事实证明，太阳辐射监测卫星一号安装的永磁铁效果良好，迫使带电粒子偏离检测器窗口，解决先锋三号任务遇到的饱和问题，确保SOLRAD/GRAB一号成为首枚成功观测太阳X射线的卫星。
en: The permanent magnets installed by Solar Radiation Monitoring Satellite I have proved to be working well, forcing electrical particles to deviate from the detector window, addressing saturation problems encountered by the Spearhead III mission and ensuring that SOLRAD/GRAB is the first satellite to successfully observe solar X-rays.

zh: 不过，磁铁与地磁场的反应导致卫星进动（像旋转的陀螺一样环绕轴线摆动），所以卫星在阳光下的半数时间里传感器都被影子挡住。
en: However, the reaction of the magnet and the geomagnetic field leads to satellite movement (rounding the axis like a spinning gyro), so the sensors are blocked by shadows for half the satellite's time in the sun.

zh: 1918年8月，巴顿获命执掌美国第1临时坦克旅（后于1918年11月6日改名为“第304坦克旅”），这支轻型坦克旅是塞缪尔·罗肯巴赫领导的坦克军的一部分，隶属美国陆军第一集团军。
en: In August 1918, Barton was appointed to the United States 1st Temporary Tank Brigade (later renamed “Turkage 304” on 6 November 1918), which is part of the tank unit led by Samuel Rokenbach and is part of the United States Army 1st Group.

zh: 巴顿亲自监督了美国军队首批实战坦克的后勤运输，还对其首轮攻击目标进行了侦察，他还下令任何一辆美军坦克都不准投降。
en: Barton personally supervised the logistical transport of the first United States army battle tanks and also reconnoitred their first attack targets, and ordered that no United States tank should surrender.

zh: 巴顿从9月12日起在圣米耶战役指挥美军的雷诺FT坦克，并且大部分时间都是在前线指挥。
en: Barton has been in command of the United States Army Renoft tanks since the battle of St. Miyet on 12 September, and has been in command of the front line for most of the time.

zh: 他走在坦克的前面进入德军把守的埃塞，在进攻帕内时也坐在最前面的一辆坦克上，希望可以以此鼓励部属。
en: He entered the German-mannered Essé in front of the tank and was also sitting on a tank in the front when he attacked Pane, which he hoped would encourage his subordinates.

zh: 两国参谋长协议，将日本逐出缅甸，重新打通与中国的陆上联系，史迪威在北部进行地面进攻，海军上将蒙巴顿指挥南部的两栖登陆，进攻孟加拉湾安达曼群岛。
en: The Chiefs of Staff of the two countries agreed to expel Japan from Myanmar and to re-establish land links with China, to launch a ground attack by Stivie in the north, and to launch an attack on the Andaman Islands in the Bay of Bengal, under the command of Admiral Mumbaton.

zh: 登陆缅甸的海盗行动将“尽快”推行，但不宜订下日期；东南亚司令部的其他方案应作进一步研究。
en: Piracy landings in Myanmar will be carried out “as soon as possible”, but no date should be set; other options for the South-East Asia Command should be further studied.

zh: 美国又告诉蒋中正，其后六个月中，每个月只有8900吨物资可以经驼峰航线空运中国，蒋中正坚持要有1万吨，美方表示打通滇缅公路的军事计划和1万吨的军援，只能任择其一，美军不能提供更多的运输工具和飞机。
en: The United States further informed Chiang that only 8,900 tons of material could be transported to China on a camel-mounted voyage each month for the next six months, that Chiang was insisting on 10,000 tons, that the United States side had indicated a military plan and 10,000 tons of military assistance to access the Phi-Myanmar highway, that only one option was available, and that the United States military could not provide more transport and aircraft.

zh: 蒋中正仍要求美国提供更多的飞机，并要求美国进行大规模行动。
en: Chiang is still asking the United States for more aircraft and for a large-scale operation.

en: Clive Anthony Stacy wrote that “stabilizing hybrid species should have a series of unique distributional, morphological and genetic characteristics that are no longer strictly related to their parentage ... If the hybrid species becomes an independent, identifiable and self-sustaining collection, it is in fact an independent species.”

en: Two examples of the origin of hybrid species are the Jurel and Mallow Pork.

en: Ali and Kinabalu have been stable enough and the status of their species has been debated.

en: The aim is to develop the resilience and physical qualities of the members, while at the same time enhancing leadership, developing team cohesion and fostering a virtuous competition between the various school officer projects.

en: Participants in the competition will receive a Ranger Challenge Skills Charter issued by the Ministry of the Army.

en: Willow will have some hymns to celebrate, such as "The Way of the Street" and "The Clouds of the Mountain".

en: The director, Steven Wydler, stated that the film was not about rape, but rather focused on “the culture in which this happens”.

en: We do not want to reveal too many details about the victims in order to maintain some suspense.”

zh: 自1997年起，入交昭一郎与IBM的山本龙太郎合作，筹组了一个约十人左右的团队，于美国秘密进行次世代硬件研发，项目代号为“黑带”；同时间，由佐藤秀树领导的日本世嘉内部团队也开始了次世代硬件的研发项目，项目代号为“白带”，后以格斗游戏《VR战士》头目角色之名改称“杜拉尔”。
en: Since 1997, Ishiro Koichiro Yamamoto and IBM have worked together to organize a team of around 10 people to conduct a second generation of hardware development in secret in the United States, codenamed “Black Belt”; at the same time, Sato Suzuki-led internal team from Japan also started a project to develop subgenerational hardware, codenamed “White Belt” and later renamed it “Dural” as the head of the fight game VR Combatants.

zh: 对于为何日本世嘉会让内部团队加入研发行列，主要有两种解释：一种说法是日本世嘉希望两地同时进行开发，另一种说法则是佐藤受高层压力影响，因而不得不投入新硬件研发项目。
en: There are two main explanations why Japan’s Socratic team has joined the R&D team: one is that Japan’s Sega wants both to develop at the same time, and the other is that Sato is affected by high-level pressure and has to invest in new hardware development.

zh: 1823年12月2日，门罗向国会发表国情咨文，其中就包含有他指示拉什的政策。
en: On 2 December 1823, Monroe delivered a State of the Nation address to the National Assembly, which included his policy of instructing Rush.

zh: 约30年后，这一政策得名“门罗主义”，其中警告欧洲国家不要再殖民美洲，也不要干涉西半球政府事务。
en: Some 30 years later, this policy was called “Menroism”, which warned European countries not to colonize the Americas, nor to interfere in the affairs of Western hemisphere Governments.

zh: 这一政策起初并没有什么实际效果，因为当时美国还没有足够的军事实力来落实这些警告，所以大多数欧洲列强根本不予理睬，觉得这不过是美国出于国家尊严所做的回应。
en: This policy did not have any practical effect at first, because the United States did not have enough military power to implement those warnings, so most European powers simply ignored it as a response to its national dignity.

zh: 19世纪30年代，英国等列强在圭亚那地区（包括如今的法属圭亚那、圭亚那和苏利南）争取土地，美国对此甚至没有发出正式抗议。
en: In the 1930s, British powers, including now French Guiana, Guyana and Surinan, were fighting for land in Guyana, and the United States did not even issue an official protest.

zh: 1846至1848年的美墨战争使拉美多个国家对门罗主义的动机产生疑虑，他们担心，美国之所以警告欧洲不要染指美洲，其实是打算将美洲逐渐划入自己的版图。
en: The US-Mer wars of 1846 and 1848 cast doubt on the motives of Monroeism in Latin America, fearing that the United States had warned Europe not to point to the Americas, in fact intended to gradually draw the Americas into its own map.

zh: 不过，门罗主义仍然是19世纪下半叶到20世纪期间美国外交政策的重要组成部分。
en: However, Monroeism remained an important component of United States foreign policy from the second half of the nineteenth to the twentieth century.

zh: 奥军7月29日占领格拉茨，随后又攻占利格尼茨和帕奇维茨，道恩所部与拉西所部返回下西里西亚与劳登所部会师。
en: On 29 July, the Austrian Army occupied Graz, followed by the capture of Lignitz and Pachvić and the return of Dorne and Lacey to their divisions in Lower Silesia and Lauden.

zh: 腓特烈二世和亨利想在会师后同奥军决战，道恩一心集中绝对优势兵力袭击腓特烈二世所部。
en: After the meeting, he and Henry wanted to go to war with the Austrian Army, and Dawn focused on the absolute strength to attack the site.

zh: 8月15日，劳登所部赶在道恩带领的主力之前在利格尼茨附近袭击腓特烈二世阵地，引发利格尼茨之战，但普军在道恩所部赶到战场前就战胜劳登。
en: On 15 August, the force of the Loudden Department attacked the Phoeid II position near Lignitz and provoked the Lignitz war, but the KPK defeated Laudden before Dawn was on the battlefield.

zh: 此次逆转打乱奥军调动，下西里西亚又落入普鲁士之手，道恩率军撤回萨克森。
en: This reversal disrupted the movements of the Austrian army, and Lower Silesia fell into the hands of Prussia, and the Dawn-led army withdrew to Saxony.

zh: 阿弗拉克的泛阿拉伯主义和阿拉伯社会主义思想曾经影响了许多阿拉伯民族主义者、尤其是年轻的知识分子，包括阿拉伯民族解放运动的领袖、埃及前总统纳赛尔以及伊拉克前总统萨达姆即深受他的影响。
en: The pan-Arabism of Afrak and the idea of Arab socialism had affected many Arab nationalists, especially young intellectuals, including the leader of the Arab National Liberation Movement, former President Nasser of Egypt and former President Saddam of Iraq.

zh: 虽然阿拉伯社会主义是由阿弗拉克提出的，但将其付诸实践的是纳赛尔，所以纳赛尔的影响力远远大于阿弗拉克。
en: Although Arab socialism was initiated by Afrak, it was Nasser who put it into practice, so Nasser had much more influence than Afrak.

zh: 阿弗拉克一手创建的复兴党夺取了叙、伊两国的政权，但他关于阿拉伯“统一、自由、社会主义”的政治理想至今未能实现，他最后反而被排斥于党的领导核心之外，被迫长期流亡，无法回到祖国，成为他个人的悲剧。
en: The Baath Party, founded by Afrak, seized power in Syria and Iraq, but his political ideal of Arab “unity, freedom, socialism” has not been realized so far, and he was eventually excluded from the core of the party's leadership and forced into exile for a long time, unable to return to his country and becoming a personal tragedy.

zh: 1914年，麦克里参与了与另外两位人选争夺民主党联邦参议员提名的竞争，这也是这年立法会议效率不高的一个重要原因。
en: In 1914, McKeley was involved in a competition with two other candidates for the Democratic Federal Senate nomination, which was an important reason for the inefficiency of the Legislative Assembly in that year.

zh: 另外两位主要候选人分别是前州长贝克汉姆和奥古斯都·O·斯坦利，还有一位候选人戴维·H·史密斯很早就退出了竞争。
en: The other two main candidates were former Governor Beckham and Augustus O. Stanley, and one candidate, David H. Smith, left the competition early on.

zh: 麦克里在竞选过程中兜售自己的成就，谈论起自己的对手时也很亲切，没有横加指责，而贝克汉姆和斯坦利则恰恰相反，竞选中处处反映出对各个对手的敌意。
en: McKeley sold his achievements during the campaign, and spoke of his rivals with kindness and without accusations, while Beckham and Stanley did the opposite, reflecting hostility to each other in the campaign.

zh: 没有了之前州长竞选中帮助自己获得提名的贝克汉姆政治机器的支持，麦克里在这场竞争中实际上毫无胜算。
en: Without the support of the Beckham political machine, which helped itself to be nominated in the previous governor's election, McKeley was virtually unwinnable in this competition.

zh: 最终贝克汉姆以72,677票胜出，斯坦利得到了65,871票，麦克里则只有20,257票。
en: In the end, Beckham won with 72,677 votes, Stanley with 65,871 votes and McKeley with 20,257 votes.

zh: 挑选者在每期节目开始时拿到一万美元现金，能凭个人喜好向其他参赛者赠送现金。
en: Selectors receive $10,000 in cash at the beginning of each programme, making cash available to other contestants on a personal basis.

zh: 挑选者还有三次淘汰竞争玩伴的权力，每次可淘汰一人，锁链大师会解开被淘汰者。
en: Selectors also have the power to phase out competition partners three times, with one person at a time, and master chains will untie the obsolete.

zh: 挑选者有权决定是否向被淘汰者赠送部分现金，只剩一名玩伴时如果两人都觉得已经建立“爱的连接”就能分掉剩余现金，也可由挑选者保留。
en: Selectors have the right to decide whether to donate part of the cash to those who have been phased out, and if both of them feel that a “love connection” has been established, they can divide the remaining cash and retain it.

zh: 最后的玩伴可以拒绝与挑选者关系更进一步。
en: The final player can refuse to go further with the picker.

zh: 1960年4月13日，美国在子午仪1B卫星上附加太阳辐射监测卫星质量模拟器并一起成功发射，证明双卫星发射技术已经成熟。
en: On 13 April 1960, the United States installed and successfully launched a solar radiation monitoring satellite mass simulator on the Meridian 1B satellite, confirming the maturity of the dual satellite launch technology.

zh: 同年5月1日，弗朗西斯·加里·鲍尔斯驾驶的U-2侦察机在苏联领空被击落，证明飞机监视十分危险。
en: On 1 May of the same year, the U-2 reconnaissance aircraft operated by Francis Gary Powers was shot down in Soviet airspace, proving that aircraft surveillance was dangerous.

zh: 5月5日，艾森豪威尔总统批准发射太阳辐射监测卫星。
en: On 5 May, President Eisenhower approved the launch of a solar radiation monitoring satellite.

zh: 杰基·华盛顿在得克萨斯州的达拉斯被控一级谋杀。
en: Jackie Washington was charged with first-degree murder in Dallas, Texas.

zh: 在法庭上，他出庭为自己作证，并极力指称是同案的另一位被告查尔斯·富勒犯下了全部罪行。
en: In court, he appeared to testify for himself and strongly alleged that another co-accused, Charles Fuller, had committed all crimes.

zh: 指称现场持有凶器（一把散弹枪）的是富勒。
en: Fowler was alleged to be in possession of the murder weapon (a shotgun).

zh: 当他试图由富勒出庭作证支持自己的说法时，法官根据州法拒绝了这一要求，因为得克萨斯的一项州法规定“被控或被定罪的多位同一案件被告人不能为彼此作证”。
en: When he tried to have Fuller testify in support of his claim, the judge rejected the request under state law, because a Texas state law provided that “many accused or convicted of the same case cannot testify for one another”.

zh: 不过这项州法并没有禁止同一案件被告人为州政府作证。
en: However, this state law does not prohibit the accused in the same case from testifying on behalf of the state government.

zh: 关岛卡布拉斯岛在台风吹袭期间有一个油罐起火，据信是因极强风力与油罐通风系统间的摩擦引起。
en: Guam ' s Cabras Island was hit by a tank fire during the typhoon, which is believed to have been caused by friction between the extreme wind power and the tank ventilation system.

zh: 油罐随后爆炸，火势因此蔓延到附近的油罐。
en: The tank subsequently exploded and the fire spread to the nearby tank.

zh: 由于这些油罐的间距很近，并且岛上水压不足，灭火工作进展缓慢，大火直到5天后才被扑灭。
en: Owing to the close proximity of the tanks and the lack of sufficient water pressure on the island, the fight against the fires was slow and was not extinguished until five days later.

zh: 这时已有3个油罐被毁，另外还有两个着火。
en: Three tanks had been destroyed and two others on fire.

zh: “反馈”专栏主编霍兰德与迈克·霍尔德内斯随后采纳读者卡沃纽斯提出的“姓名决定论”为假说命名，在12月17日《新科学人》首度刊发。
en: The editor-in-chief of the feedback column, Holland and Mike Holdnes, then adopted the pseudonym “names determination theory” proposed by the reader Cavronius, which was first published in New Scientists on 17 December.

zh: 此后数十年间杂志多次想要中止话题，但读者持续发来引人好奇的范例，如回答记者事涉关塔那摩湾拘押中心提问的美国海军发言人麦克·卡夫卡中校，《帝国动物》的作者莱昂内尔·泰格尔与罗宾·福克斯，英国警察局长协会刀具罪案科发言人阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克。
en: The magazine has tried to stop the subject for decades, but readers continue to send curious examples, such as the answer to the journalist's question about Guantánamo. Lieutenant Colonel Mike Kafka, United States Navy spokesman at the Mo Bay Detention Centre; Lionel Tegel and Robin Fox, authors of Imperial Animals; and Alfred Hitchcock, spokesperson of the Blade Crime Section of the British Police Chiefs Association.

zh: 在最初的讨论会上，最高法院多数大法官愿意回避密苏里妥协案的合宪性和黑人的公民权这两个问题，并遵照“斯特雷德诉格雷厄姆案”的判例，即斯科特的身份由密苏里州法院决定，既然密苏里州最高法院认为他是奴隶，那他就是奴隶。
en: During the initial discussions, the majority of the Supreme Court judges were willing to avoid the constitutionality of the Missouri compromise and the citizenship of blacks, and to follow the jurisprudence of the Strad v. Graham case, according to which Scott's status was determined by the Missouri Regional Court and, since the Missouri Supreme Court considered him a slave, he was a slave.

zh: 1857年，2月14日，纳尔逊大法官甚至拟好了判词。
en: In 1857, on 14 February, Lord Nelson even elaborated his sentence.

zh: 但在第二次讨论会上，韦恩大法官提议判决应该处理纳尔逊忽略的两个关键性问题。
en: However, at the second seminar, Lord Wayne proposed that the judgement should address two key issues that Nelson had neglected.

zh: 韦恩的动议得到了首席大法官坦尼的支持，5名来自南方的大法官投票支持更新判决，并由首席大法官坦尼撰写新判决。
en: Wayne's motion was supported by Chief Justice Tani, who voted in favour of the renewal of the judgement and who wrote the new judgement.

zh: 鉴于疫情期间口罩的全球供应不足，世界卫生组织建议通过远程医疗减少个人防护设备的需求。
en: Given the global supply of masks during the epidemic, the World Health Organization recommended reducing the demand for personal protective equipment through telemedicine.

zh: 并通过透明窗口等物理屏障，只允许直接护理肺炎患者的人员进入病房，以减少N95口罩等个人防护设备的使用。
en: Through physical barriers such as transparent windows, only persons who directly care for pneumonia patients are allowed into wards to reduce the use of personal protective equipment such as N95 masks.

zh: 南越国因为是在秦朝岭南三郡的基础上建立起来的，并且南越国的开国君主赵佗也曾为秦朝的南海郡尉，所以南越国的政治制度大部分是沿袭秦朝的；后来因为又臣属于汉朝，所以汉朝的政治制度对南越国的影响也很大。
en: The political system of the South Viet Nam was largely followed by the Qin Dynasty, since it was built on the basis of the Qin Dynasty and the three southern counties of the Qin Dynasty, and Zhao Zhao, the founding sovereign of the South Viet Nam, was also a captain of the Qin Dynasty.

zh: 同时，南越国是个独立性很大的政权，他们的统治者也制定了一些独特的政治制度。
en: At the same time, the South Viet Nam is a highly independent regime whose rulers have developed some unique political systems.

zh: 这场飓风至少夺走了14人的生命，其中格林纳达1人，牙买加4人，加勒比地区7人，墨西哥2人。
en: The hurricane claimed at least 14 lives, including one in Grenada, four in Jamaica, seven in the Caribbean and two in Mexico.

zh: 估计风暴还造成5.5亿美元损失，其中绝大部分发生在格林纳达和墨西哥的金塔纳罗奥州。
en: The storm also caused an estimated $550 million in losses, most of which occurred in Grenada and Quintana Roo in Mexico.

zh: 艾米莉最后一次登陆还在墨西哥东北部和得克萨斯州最南端引发轻度洪灾，但造成的破坏程度很轻。
en: Emily ' s last landing caused light flooding in north-east Mexico and the southernmost part of Texas, but the damage was low.

zh: 黑尔戈兰级战列舰参加了在1916年5月31日至6月1日爆发、未分胜负的日德兰海战。
en: Helgoran warships participated in the undistributed Hadran war that broke out between 31 May and 1 June 1916.

zh: 在战斗的大部分时间里，它们所属的第一战列分舰队都位处战列线的中心，紧随在海军少将保罗·贝恩克率领的第三战列分舰队之后，但领先于弗朗茨·毛弗率领、由年迈的前无畏舰组成的第二战列分舰队。
en: For most of the fighting, their first column was at the centre of the battle line, immediately following the third column led by Admiral Paul Bernk, but ahead of the second column led by Franz Mauf, made up of the old former fearless ship.

zh: 东弗里斯兰号担任支队的旗舰，由海军中将埃哈德·施密特指挥。
en: The Eastern Frislan is the flagship of the detachment, under the command of Admiral Ehad Schmidt.

zh: 在完成调试编入海军序列后，巴登号取代腓特烈大帝号成为了公海舰队的旗舰。
en: Following the completion of the calibration into the naval sequence, the Baden became the flagship of the high seas fleet, replacing the Phoeche Emperor.

zh: 它在短暂的生涯中仅参加过小规模行动；其唯一的主要出击是在1918年4月，但最终没有任何开火。
en: During its short career, it took part only in small-scale operations; its only major strike was in April 1918, but eventually no fire was fired.

zh: 随着德国在1918年11月投降，巴登号与大多数公海舰队的舰只被英国皇家海军扣押在斯卡帕湾。
en: With the surrender of Germany in November 1918, the Baden and most of the fleets of the high seas were detained only by the Royal Navy in Skapa Bay.

zh: 1919年6月21日，海军少将路德维希·冯·罗伊特作为被扣押的舰队指挥官，下令全数凿沉舰队。
en: On 21 June 1919, Rear Admiral Ludwig von Ryote, as the commanding officer of the captured fleet, ordered the full wreckage of the fleet.

zh: 然而，港口内的英国水兵却成功登上巴登号并将它拖上岸边以防止下沉。
en: However, the British sailors in the port succeeded in boarding the Baden and dragging it to shore to prevent sinking.

zh: 舰体被重新浮起后进行了彻底检查，并作为靶舰最终于1921年在皇家海军进行大量的射击测试后沉没。
en: The vessel was resurfaced and thoroughly inspected and eventually sunk as a target ship after extensive firing tests by the Royal Navy in 1921.

zh: 1900年夏季奥林匹克运动会于法国巴黎举行，始于5月终于10月，是第二届现代奥运会。
en: The 1900 Summer Olympic Games were held in Paris, France, and began in May and finally in October as the second modern Olympic Games.

zh: 现代奥运会发起人皮埃尔·德·顾拜旦原定只接受男性参赛，但在1900年，奥运会却放宽资格，允许女性参与高尔夫、网球、帆船、赛艇、马术五项比赛。
en: While Pierre de Corbaitan, the founder of the modern Olympic Games, was supposed to accept only men, in 1900 the Games relaxed their qualifications to allow women to participate in the five games of golf, tennis, sailboat, boat and horsemanship.

zh: 这届奥运会共有997名运动员参与，当中22名是女性。
en: The Olympics were attended by 997 athletes, 22 of whom were women.

zh: 另一方面，大会在劣质场地上举行比赛且未有提供适当设备，没有正式的开幕和闭幕仪式，竞赛项目亦包括拔河、放风筝、热气球、赛鸽等。
en: On the other hand, the General Assembly held competitions in poor-quality venues without proper equipment and without a formal opening and closing ceremony. The competitions also included raising rivers, kites, hot balloons, doves, etc.

zh: 奥运会设两场高尔夫球比赛，其中男子个人项目属于36洞赛，女子个人项目则是九洞赛，距离由62米（68码）至210米（230码）不等。
en: The Olympic Games have two golf games, of which the men ' s personal project is a 36-hole race and the women ' s individual project is a nine-hole race, ranging from 62 metres (68 yards) to 210 metres (230 yards).

zh: 10月4日，女子赛事于巴黎以北约48千米（30英里）的贡比涅举行。
en: On 4 October, the women's competition took place in Gombini, 48 km (30 miles) north of Paris.

zh: 在真菌病毒学的研究中，感染栗疫病菌的CHV1病毒相当重要，这种病毒作为生物防治剂，在欧洲已能有效控制栗疫病的疫情，且此病毒本身也是此领域研究中重要的模式生物。
en: In the study of fungal virology, the importance of the CHV1 virus, which is infected with the Chestnut virus, as a biological control agent, has been effective in controlling the outbreak in Europe, and the virus itself is an important model in research in this field.

zh: 不过美洲与亚洲栗疫病菌的基因多样性较大，有些菌株对CHV1病毒具有抗性，而使这些地区以CHV1病毒进行生物防治的效果有限。
en: However, the genetic diversity of the Chestnut disease bacteria in the Americas and Asia is greater, with some strains resistant to the CHV1 virus, and the biological control of the CHV1 virus in these regions is limited.

zh: 2016年已有用基因工程改造的CHV1病毒被制造出来，能感染多数栗疫病菌的菌株，可望在栗疫病病情的控制得到更大成效。
en: A genetically engineered CHV1 virus was manufactured in 2016, with strains capable of infecting most of the disease, and is expected to be more effective in controlling the disease.

zh: 众多波利尼西亚文化把乌鸦座恒星划为星座。
en: Many Polynesian cultures have classified crow stars as constellations.

zh: 马克萨斯群岛把星座称为“米”，普卡普卡岛称为“蒂玛努”，社会群岛称为“梅图艾帕帕”。。
en: The Marquesas Islands refer to the constellation as “m”, the island of Pucapuka as “Timanu” and the social archipelago as “Metu Aipapa”.

zh: 托雷斯海峡岛民把乌鸦座视为代表渔民的右手，组成巨大的“塔改座”。
en: Torres Strait Islander views the crow as representing the right hand of the fisherman and constitutes a huge “chamber seat”.

zh: 巴伐利亚的卡尔需要军事援助才能以武力夺取帝国头衔，并为此签署了《宁芬堡条约》（1741年7月）。
en: Kaal in Bavaria needed military assistance to take the imperial title by force and signed the Ningvenburg Treaty (July 1741) to that end.

zh: 在随后的奥地利王位继承战争中，他成功地占领了布拉格，并在那里加冕为波希米亚国王。
en: In the ensuing war of succession to the Austrian throne, he successfully occupied Prague, where he crowned the King of Bohemia.

zh: 他还入侵上奥地利，计划占领维也纳，但外交上的紧急情况使他的计划变得复杂。
en: He also invaded Austria and planned to occupy Vienna, but the diplomatic emergency complicated his plan.

zh: 他的法国盟友将军队重新调入波希米亚，在那里，普鲁士新王腓特烈大帝利用奥地利和巴伐利亚的混乱吞并了西里西亚。
en: His French allies re-deployed their troops to Bohemia, where the new King of Prussia, the King of Prussia, used the chaos of Austria and Bavaria to annex Silesia.

zh: 由于位处一个副热带高压脊的西部外围沿线，低气压稳定向西北方向前进，并且接下来其存在期间都将总体保持这一前进方向。
en: Due to its location along the western periphery of a sub-tropical high-pressure ridge, the low pressure has stabilized in the north-west direction and will remain generally in this direction for the remainder of its life.

zh: 8月11日晚，系统增强成热带风暴并获命名为乔杰特，并于两天后发展出65公里宽的风眼，在卡波圣卢卡斯西南偏南方向约990公里海域升级成飓风。
en: On the night of 11 August, the system was enhanced to tropical storm Chojette and, two days later, a 65-km wide wind eye was developed, escalating to a hurricane in the south-west of Santa Lucas, Capo, about 990 km.

zh: 随着带状特征变得非常层次分明，风眼也变得越来越清晰。
en: As the belt features become very hierarchical, so does the wind eye.

zh: 乔杰特在下加利福尼亚州最南端的西南偏西方向约1110公里洋面达到最大持续风速每小时185公里的最高强度。
en: In the southernmost south-west, south-west of Baja California, Jorget reached a maximum of 185 km per hour at a sustained wind speed of approximately 1110 km.

zh: 接下来飓风很快进入水温较低的海域，对流温度升高并逐渐减少，气旋开始减弱。
en: The next hurricane quickly entered the lower water-temperature waters, increasing and decreasing the convection temperature and beginning to weaken.

zh: 8月16日，乔杰特降级成热带风暴，再于8月17日消散，没有对陆地构成影响。
en: On 16 August, Joedjet was downgraded to a tropical storm and dispersed on 17 August without impact on land.

zh: 孩子们带叭噗去吃自助餐，叭噗震惊地发现，这里的居民消耗的食物同他的故乡相比分量完全不在一个数量级，而且卡特曼对待食品还非常浪费。
en: The children went to the buffet with a bang and were shocked to discover that the food consumed by the inhabitants was not in any order of magnitude compared to his home country, and that Cartman was wasteful of food.

zh: 孩子们带叭噗去上学，加里森先生宣布捐赠食品的计划失败了，因为所有学生带来的只有几罐奶油玉米。
en: The children went to school with a bang, and Mr. Garrison announced that the donation of food had failed because all the students had brought in only a few cans of cream corn.

zh: 卡特曼等人在课堂上的展示和讲解环节向大家介绍叭噗，加里森和校长维多利亚之后告知孩子们，他们有义务通知红十字会，把叭噗送回故乡。
en: Cartman and others introduced to the group at the classroom, and Garrison and Principal Victoria later informed the children that they had an obligation to inform the Red Cross and to return it to their homes.

zh: 与此同时，墨菲斯托博士向厨师证明，火鸡的DNA正急剧膨胀，如果不加阻止，这些火鸡可能会取代人类统治世界。
en: At the same time, Dr. Mephisto confirmed to the cook that the turkey DNA was swelling sharply and, if unchecked, they could replace human domination of the world.

zh: 锗的一些化合物对哺乳类动物没什么毒性，可是对某些细菌则有着相当的毒性。
en: Some of the compounds are not very toxic to mammals but are quite toxic to some bacteria.

zh: 就因为这项特性，所以这些锗化合物可用作化学治疗剂。
en: As a result of this characteristic, these thallium compounds can be used as chemical agents.

zh: 据神学家哈桑·巴斯里描述，穆罕默德作为伊玛目领祷众位先知，确立了他在先知当中的超然地位。
en: According to the theologian Hassan Basri, Mohamed, as an imam, received prayers for the prophets and established his supremacy among them.

zh: 穆罕默德形容了其他先知的形象，如摩西身材瘦削，有一头直发；耶稣的身高中等，脸色潮红。
en: Muhammad described the image of other prophets, such as Moses, who was thin and had a straight head; Jesus had a high school, etc., and had a red face.

zh: 至于穆罕默德在夜行登霄的过程当中是否面对面看到真主则有不同的说法，阿卜杜拉·本·阿拔斯、阿纳斯·伊本·马利克及伊克里玛·穆拉·阿巴斯都认同穆罕默德见到了真主，但与穆罕默德后娶的妻子阿伊莎的说法矛盾。
en: As to whether Mohamed saw God face to face during the nightingale process, there were different accounts of Abdullah Bin Abbas, Anas Ibn Malik and Ikrima Mula Abbas who agreed that he had seen God, but contradicted the claim that the wife he had married was Aisha.

zh: 阿伊莎指出穆罕默德在当晚没有下床，所以夜行登霄是一次精神上的旅行。
en: Aisha pointed out that Mohammed had not been out of bed that night, so the night trip was a spiritual journey.

zh: 《东离剑游纪》是台湾布袋戏首次与日本跨界合作的特摄作品，剧名由霹雳董事长黄强华命名。
en: East Flying Sword Quest was the first special feature of Taiwan's bag of cross-border cooperation with Japan. The title of the show was named by Mr. Wong Guanghua, President of Thunderbolt.

zh: 制作团队成员为虚渊玄担任编剧与总监修。
en: The production team is working as a writer and director.

zh: 布袋戏拍摄由霹雳执行，总导演由黄强华担任，执行导演为王嘉祥、郑保品、王泉修，由厂长汪绍权、李宗翰、赵军贤带领旗下的操偶师廖嘉升、洪嘉章、吴圣恩、萧仪村、曾瑞荣、丁振清、刘招星、李易修、邱仲文和吴宜谦等操演人偶。
en: The bag was filmed by a thunderbolt, headed by Wong Keung-hwa and directed by Wang Kai-sheng, Zheng Bao-Sheng, Wang Quan, Wang Quanxiang, Li Zhonghan, Zhao Jun-hyun, Liao Ga-sung, Hong Ka-sung, Wu Xiann, Xiao Yi village, Zhu Shun, Jin Zhenqing, Liu Zhengxing, Li Yi-shu, Zheng Wen and Wu Yi-King.

zh: 11月19日，有网民发现11月6日举行的世界杯榄球赛终极复活赛香港对葡萄牙的比赛精华片段中的英文字幕显示香港国歌为《愿荣光归香港》。
en: On November 19, netizens discovered that the English subtitles in the final revival of the World Cup on November 6th showed Hong Kong's national anthem as "Hong Kong's Glory."

zh: 另外，网上亦流传早于2022年7月23日举行的一场世界杯榄球赛香港对汤加的赛事中，有歌手唱出中国国歌时，精华片段的字幕却出现《愿荣光归香港》的英文译名。
en: In addition, an English translation of "Hong Kong's Glory" appeared in the song of the Chinese National Anthem by singers in a World Cup game between Hong Kong and Tonga held earlier than July 23, 2022.

zh: 1890年铸币法案中止了多种过时面额硬币的生产授权，3美币硬币就是其中之一。
en: One of the many obsolete coins that were suspended from production by the Castery Act of 1890 was the three-dollar coin.

zh: 1890年9月26日，联邦国会通过另一项法案，要求硬币设计要在生产25年后才能更换，除非在此期间得到国会批准。
en: On 26 September 1890, the Federal Congress passed another bill requiring that coin designs be replaced after 25 years of production, unless approved by Congress during that period.

zh: 不过，后一项法案并没有明确规定，当时的5美分硬币和银元都需要在生产25年后才重新设计。
en: However, the latter Act does not make it clear that the then five cents of coins and silver will need to be redesigned 25 years after production.

zh: 联邦众议院要求财政部长递交报告，说明使用各种金属打造硬币的优势和缺点。
en: The Federal Chamber of Deputies requested the Minister of Finance to submit a report on the advantages and disadvantages of using various metals to build coins.

zh: 为此铸币局在试铸过带孔硬币后于1896年制作了多枚图案币，这也是1885年后该局首次生产图案币，下一次打造图案镍币则要到1909年。
en: For this reason, the Bureau produced several graph coins in 1896, after having tested the strip coin, which was the first graph coin to be produced by the Bureau after 1885 and the next graph nickel to 1909.

zh: 1891年末州议会召开会议时，布朗报告称自己委任了一个委员会，研究新宪法会对州内已有法律产生何等影响。
en: In late 1891, when the State Council met, Brown reported that he had appointed a committee to study the impact of the new Constitution on existing State laws.

zh: 他还宣布州内当时的预算赤字为22.9万美元，估计到1893年末会达到近50万美元。
en: He also announced a budget deficit of $229,000 in the counties at the time, which was expected to reach nearly $500,000 by the end of 1893.

zh: 面对这两个大问题，州议会从1891年12月到1893年7月几乎一直都在开会。
en: Faced with these two major problems, the State Council met almost always from December 1891 to July 1893.

zh: 这一议程持续时间之长也招来了嘲笑式的绰号：“长期议会”。
en: The duration of this agenda has also drawn the scoffing nickname “long-term parliament”.

zh: 会期如此之长还部分是因为州众议院和州参议院都难以凑齐法定人数，根据路易斯维尔的一家报纸报道，州众议院在其中整整一个月的时间里出席的议员人数最多也只有61人（共100人）。
en: Part of the reason for the length of the meeting was the difficulty of having a quorum in both the State House of Representatives and the State Senate, which, according to a newspaper in Louisville, had a maximum of 61 members (100 in total) for the entire month.

zh: 这也导致部分法案只能由法定人数的多数通过，但这个多数还没有超过议员总数的半数，结果布朗因担心这些法案会在法院受到质疑而选择了将其否决。
en: This has also led to the passage of some bills by a quorum majority, which has not yet exceeded half of the total number of parliamentarians, and as a result Brown chose to veto them for fear that they would be challenged in court.

zh: 纯种马偶尔会出现拥有一个巨大的心脏的情况，而这被称为“X因素”，是假定与遗传条件有关并会以特定的遗传模式传予下一代。
en: Pure horses occasionally have a large heart, which is called an “X factor”, assuming that genetic conditions are relevant and transmitted to the next generation in a particular genetic pattern.

zh: “X因素”可以追溯至一匹在历史上著名的的竞赛马日蚀，它在1789年去世后被解剖，而这场解剖更被认为是英国有史以来第一次具备正式记录的动物尸体解剖。
en: The “X factor” can be traced back to a historically well-known raced horse eclipse, which was dissected after its death in 1789, and which is more considered the first animal autopsies in British history with official records.

zh: 兽医在进行解剖工作时发现它的心脏比其他马匹的为大，称重后得知其心脏的重量是14磅，几乎是正常心脏重量的两倍。
en: In an autopsy, the vet found its heart to be larger than the rest of the horses, and when weighed, it learned that its heart weighs 14 pounds, almost twice the weight of the normal heart.

zh: 透过谱系研究，证实了秘书处的母系能够追溯至日蚀的女儿，而秘书处能成为北美著名母马的父系马可能与“X因素”有关。
en: Spectrum studies have confirmed that the matrilineals of the Secretariat can be traced back to the daughters of solar eclipse, and that the patrilineal horses in which the Secretariat can become a famous mother in North America may be associated with the “X factor”.

zh: 有研究亦证明很多取得巨大成功的纯种竞赛马皆拥有巨大的心脏。
en: Research has also proved that many pure races with great success have huge hearts.

zh: 阿尔贝特国王号是以“埃吉尔代舰”作为合同代号进行订购，以取代过时的岸防舰埃吉尔号，并于1910年7月17日在但泽的希肖船厂开始架设龙骨，至1912年4月27日舰体完工并下水。
en: King Albert ordered the “Egil” as contract designer to replace the obsolete shore defence vessel Egir, and on 17 July 1910 began the laying of the dragon bones at the Shicho factory in Danzig, until 27 April 1912, when the body was completed and watered.

zh: 在下水仪式上，由萨克森公主玛蒂尔德主持为之命名，而其长兄弗里德里希·奥古斯特三世作为萨克森的末代国王，即舰只得名者——阿尔贝特国王的侄子，则在下水仪式上发表演讲。
en: The ceremony was named under the chairmanship of Princess Mathilde Saxon, while his elder brother, Friedrich August III, who was the last king of Saxon, the nephew of King Albert, who had only the name of the ship, gave a speech at the ceremony.

zh: 舾装工作完成后，该舰于1913年7月31日投入舰队服役。
en: Upon completion of the assembly work, the ship entered the fleet on 31 July 1913.

zh: 在17:48至17:52之间，波森号与另外十艘德国战列舰迎向英国第2轻巡洋舰分舰队开火，但射程和能见度不佳影响了有效射击，并很快作罢。
en: Between 1748 and 1752 hours, the Bosen and 10 other German battleships opened fire on the British 2nd Light cruiser fleet, but the low range and visibility affected the effective firing and quickly stopped.

zh: 此后不久，两艘英国驱逐舰——涅斯托耳号和游牧民号都遭到德国战列线的猛烈攻击。
en: Shortly thereafter, two British destroyers — Nistore and Nomad — came under heavy attack from the German line.

zh: 其中波森号以其主炮及副炮持续向涅斯托耳号开火。
en: Among them, the Bosen continued to fire at the Nistore with its main and secondary artillery.

zh: 至18:35，该舰在八艘德国战列舰的联合火力下爆炸沉没。
en: Up to 1835, the ship exploded and sunk under the combined fire of eight German battleships.

zh: 在20:15，德国舰队第二次面对已展开成战斗队形的大舰队，被迫转向离去；在此过程中，德国战列线的序列被颠倒，波森号号成为领头的第四艘舰，位居其三艘姊妹舰之后。
en: At 2015, for the second time, the German fleet was forced to depart in the face of a large fleet that had been launched into combat formation; in the process, the sequence of the German battle line was reversed and the Bossen became the fourth leading ship, behind its three sister ships.

zh: 10月25日，麦克米伦飞抵哥伦比亚特区谈判。
en: On 25 October, McMillen flew to the District of Columbia for negotiations.

zh: 他担心10月10日导致重大灾难的温斯乔火灾会成为谈判的绊脚石，因为这场火灾表明英国在核安全问题上还不够专业，而且对于反对与英国合作的美国人来说，这无疑是非常有力的论据。
en: He feared that the 10 October fire in Winscho would be a stumbling block to negotiations, because it showed that Britain was not sufficiently professional on nuclear safety issues and that it was certainly a very strong argument for Americans opposed to working with Britain.

zh: 他下令只保留必须的火灾报告，其他的和印刷字模一起销毁。
en: He ordered that only the required fire reports be kept and that the rest be destroyed together with the printed template.

zh: 麦克米伦很快发现美国人对斯普特尼克1号十分紧张，导致艾森豪威尔政府受到极大的公众压力，要求他们采取行动部署远程弹道导弹，安抚震惊且心急如焚的民众。
en: MacMillen quickly discovered that Americans were very nervous about Sputnik 1, causing the Eisenhower administration to come under great public pressure to take action to deploy long-range ballistic missiles to reassure a shocked and anxious population.

zh: 风暴在最高强度下保持了约6小时，印度气象局于6月4日晚将古努降级成特强气旋风暴。
en: The storm remained at its highest intensity for about six hours, and on the night of 4 June, the Indian Meteorological Service downgraded Gunu to a particularly powerful cyclone.

zh: 气旋的风眼内开始有云层遮盖并变得模糊，并因逼近阿拉伯半岛期间行经海域水温渐低、空气变得干燥而逐渐减弱。
en: The wind of the cyclone began to be cloud-covered and blurred, and gradually weakened by the low water temperature and dry air of the sea during its approach to the Arabian peninsula.

zh: 古努同阿曼陆地相互影响，其深层对流的内层核心迅速消亡，风力时速经过24小时后已下降95公里。
en: Gunu interacted with Omani land, and the inner core of the deep convection quickly collapsed, with wind speed dropping 95 kilometres per hour after 24 hours.

zh: 据印度气象局记载，气旋于6月6日清晨从阿曼最东端经过，并且这时仍有特强气旋风暴强度。
en: The Indian Meteorological Service recorded that the cyclone passed from the far east of Oman in the early morning hours of 6 June and that the intensity of the cyclone was still high.

zh: 古努的风速还在逐渐减缓，但整体结构却在登陆数小时前略有改善，风眼虽然模糊，但下层结构依然层次分明。
en: The wind rate in Gunu is still slowing, but the overall structure has improved slightly a few hours before landing, and although the wind eye is vague, the lower structure remains stratified.

zh: 虽然韩国政府并未请求国际社会援助，但还是有多个国家主动伸出援手。
en: Although his Government had not requested assistance from the international community, a number of countries had offered to do so.

zh: 台风过去数天后，美国国际开发署向韩国红十字会赠送5万美元。
en: The United States Agency for International Development gave $50,000 to the Korean Red Cross several days after the typhoon.

en: Since then, the Government of Japan has also donated relief supplies, including sleeping mats, generators and water containers, at a price of 9.5 million yen (Yen Yen 2003, equivalent to $85,000 in the same year).

zh: 台湾也提供了10万美元的援助金。

zh: 韩国红十字会通过700名志愿者和200名工作人员，向8190户居民分发食品和毛毯，地方官员则提供了5500余顿膳食。
en: Through 700 volunteers and 200 staff, the Korean Red Cross distributed food and blankets to 8190 households, while local officials provided over 5,500 meals.

en: Food for Hunger International staff sent food and clothing to victims of the storm in Masan City.

en: The Special Districts belong to a special local public body and in principle exercise local self-government powers equivalent to those of the general municipal village of Machi (although wide-area affairs such as sewage and sewage and fire fighting are managed by Tokyo), the Regional Chiefs are elected by popular vote, and the municipal districts of the municipalities designated by decree are not administrative units of the same rank.

zh: 多摩地区及岛屿地区各市町村的地方自治权限和日本其他地方相同。
en: The local self-government authority in the Domá region and in the island areas is the same as in the rest of Japan.

zh: 2015年，八王子市成为东京都第一个中核市，拥有比其他市更多的条例制定权。
en: In 2015, Prince VIII became the first nuclear market in Tokyo, with more regulatory powers than in other cities.

zh: 许多游客会通过泛美公路来到安巴托。
en: Many tourists come to Ambato via the Pan American Highway.

zh: 这座城市以拥有销售广泛类别商品的市场而闻名，其中包括当地的美食和鲜花，一些久远的屋苑成了历史性的公园，其中部分还在地震前就已存在。

en: The trade silver dollar, which is slightly larger than the standard silver dollar, was issued mainly for shipments to China, rather than locally in the United States, but just before the bill was passed, Congress added amendments to give the trade silver dollar a statutory ceiling of $5.

en: In such cases, the banks ' insistence on the 5-dollar cap would create a contradiction.

en: Other problems followed, with some employers buying trade money at low prices and then paying their employees at nominal value, who were forced to accept it but were naturally dissatisfied.

zh: 血管紧张素转化酶2主要的功能是与血管紧张素转化酶拮抗，ACE可将无活性的血管紧张素Ⅰ切割成血管紧张素II，后者可促进抗利尿激素与醛固酮的分泌，以及刺激血管平滑肌收缩，使血压上升；ACE2则分解血管紧张素Ⅰ和血管紧张素II以抑制其作用，将其C端的氨基酸移除，分别将前者转化成血管紧张素(1-9)，将后者转化成血管紧张素(1-7)，其中切割血管紧张素II比切割血管紧张素I的能力高出许多，切割的产物中，血管紧张素(1-9)的功能不明，血管紧张素(1-7)则可刺激一氧化氮合成、抑制MAPK/ERK途径与TGFβ途径、以及抑制活性氧物质的生成，因此在心血管组织中有抗氧化与抗炎等功能。
en: The main function of an vascular tension transformation enzyme 2 is to convert an enzyme with an vascular stressor. The ACE can resist by cutting inert vascular stressor I into an vascular stressor II, which can contribute to the degeneration of anti-urea hormones and hysterone, as well as to the constriction of vascular smooth muscles, increasing blood pressure; ACE2 can decompose vascular stressor I and vascular stressor II to inhibit their effects, removing its C-end amino acid, converting the former into an vascular stressor (1-9) and the latter into an vascular stressor (1-7), which is much more capable of cutting vascular stressor II than cutting vascular stressor I, and in the products of cutting vascular stressor (1-9), the function of vascular stressor (1-7), which can stimulate the synthesis of nitrous oxide, inhibiting the MAPK/ERK route and the TGF beta route, and inhibiting the generation of active oxygen, and thus has antioxidation and antiinitis functions in cardiovascular tissues.

zh: 许多研究结果显示ACE2表现量的下降与数种心血管疾病相关。

en: The Minister of the Interior is the head of the national police force, paramilitary forces (gendarme) and secret police.

en: Historically, Madagascar has been relatively safe, with low rates of violent crime, and most criminal activities have been limited to opportunistic crimes such as theft or petty theft, although the proportion of illicit drug cultivation and sale, such as child prostitution, trafficking in persons and cannabis, is on the rise.

en: He also informed the Commission that in 1903 the Castery Authority produced a total of 250,000 dollar coins to commemorate the centennial of the purchase of land in Louisiana, which eventually sold only thirty-seven hundred and fifty thousand coins, leaving only the remainder to melt; and that it also had millions of Burke Washington to commemorate half a dollar and Cave-Washington half a dollar stocks, which were likely to melt.

en: According to the Assistant Director, the circulation of half a dollar of commemorative coins was small, so production costs were higher than the equivalent in circulation.

en: The battleship Baden is a Bavaria class super-daunted warship built by the German Imperial Navy during World War I.

en: The vessel was equipped with eight 380-mm main guns distributed among the four double-mounted towers, with a capacity of 32,200 tons, with a maximum speed of 21 knots (39 km per hour; 24 miles per hour).

en: The Baden, together with its sister vessel Bavaria, is the largest and most powerful armoured battleship built by the Imperial Navy.

zh: CDC建议使用具有至少N95认证的防护口罩，以防止佩戴者吸入传染性微粒，包括结核杆菌，禽流感，严重急性呼吸道综合征，流感和埃博拉病毒。
en: CDC recommends the use of protective masks with at least N95 certification to prevent inhalation of infectious particles, including tuberculosis fungi, avian influenza, severe acute respiratory syndrome, influenza and Ebola virus.

zh: 哈佛法学院教授劳伦斯·特莱伯于1979年写道：“法院由此维持了全美大多数高校所实行的肯定性行动政策，只有在这个不同寻常的情况下——有些人会说是不同寻常的坦诚，有些会说是不同寻常的失策——才取缔了医学院的政策。”
en: The Harvard Law School professor, Lawrence Treber, wrote in 1979: "The Court has thus maintained the policy of affirmative action at most universities in the United States, only in this unusual case -- – Some would say extraordinary honesty, some would say extraordinary failure — the policy of medical schools was abolished.”

en: On 12 July, the Fourth Fleet carried out an offensive and returned to Danzig on 21 July without encountering Russian troops.

zh: 马里恩军事学院是一所小规模的高等教育机构，学员总数通常在420人左右，学员与教职员工的比例为16：1，教学模式为小班级授课。
en: The Marion Military Academy is a small higher education institution, usually with a total of about 420 students, with a ratio of 16:1 students to teaching staff, and a teaching model for small classes.

zh: 目前该校仅招收美国公民，学员均为全日制学生，并要求住校以接受军事化管理，学员毕业率通常在25%左右。
en: At present, only United States citizens are enrolled in the school, who are full-time students and are required to stay in the school to be militarized, with a completion rate of around 25 per cent.

zh: 作为一所两年制军事学院，马里恩军事学院通常授予毕业学员文理、通识、人文学副学士学位，目前有领导力、刑事司法、历史、工程预备、护理预备、自然科学、心理学、社会学等具体专业供学员选择，学员必须在相关领域修满15学分的课程才能获得该专业的文凭。
en: As a two-year military academy, the Marion Military Academy usually grants graduates a bachelor ' s degree in literature, general knowledge and humanities, and currently offers candidates for specific specializations such as leadership, criminal justice, history, engineering preparation, nursing preparation, natural sciences, psychology and sociology, for which they must complete 15 credits in the relevant fields.

zh: 不过，无论选择哪种专业，都必须修满两学年的陆军军事科学课程。
en: However, military science courses in the army must be completed for two years, regardless of the profession chosen.

zh: 由于历史上的特殊关系，学员还可以选择在贾德森学院选修部分课程。
en: Due to historical specialties, participants may also choose to take part in courses at Judson College.

zh: 马里恩学员通常根据发展路线的不同还分为几大课程计划，主要有提前授衔计划、联邦军校预科计划、领导力教育计划等。
en: Malen trainees are usually divided into several major courses, depending on their development path, including the pre-licensing programme, the preparatory programme for the Federal Military Academy and the leadership education programme.

zh: 早期定居者以阿朗佐·A·斯金纳之名把这座山峰命名成斯金纳峰，他是1851到1853年间罗格谷的印第安事务代理。
en: Early settlers named the mountain peak Skinner in the name of Alonzo A. Skinner, an Indian affairs agent in the Valley between 1851 and 1853.

zh: 山峰如今使用的名称源于罗克西·安·鲍恩，她是这里最早的定居者之一。
en: The name used today by the mountain is from Roxy Ann Bowen, one of the first settlers here.

zh: 1853年，罗克西·安·鲍恩和丈夫约翰·鲍恩，以及斯蒂芬·泰勒和玛丽·泰勒两对夫妇宣布拥有几乎整座山峰的土地所有权，到了19世纪50年代末，这座山开始以罗克西·安峰之名为人所知。
en: In 1853, Roxy Ann Bowen and his husband John Bowen, as well as Stephen Taylor and Mary Taylor, declared their ownership of almost the entire mountain peak, which, by the end of the 1950s, began to be known under the name of Roxy Anfung.

zh: 1861年冬，约翰逊试图确立这个羽翼未丰政府的合法性，但临时政府的管辖范围一直都没有超出南军控制的地区范围。
en: In the winter of 1861, Johnson tried to establish the legitimacy of this unfavoured Government, but the interim Government remained within the reach of areas under the control of the VJ.

zh: 邦联国会要求约翰逊征召4.6万的部队，但他无法办到。
en: The Union Congress requested Johnson to recruit 46,000 troops, but he was unable to do so.

zh: 临时政府在征税和强迫公民上缴武器方面也收效甚微。
en: The Interim Government has also had little success in taxing and forcing citizens to surrender their weapons.

zh: 1862年1月3日，约翰逊向邦联国会请求拨款300万美元（相当于2026年的9700万美元）作为临时政府的运作开销。
en: On 3 January 1862, Johnson requested $3 million (equivalent to $97 million in 2026) from the Union Congress to fund the operations of the interim Government.

zh: 邦联国会最终只批准了200万美元，这些开销还需要战争部长犹大·本杰明和总统戴维斯的审批。
en: The Union Congress eventually approved only $2 million, and these expenses will require the approval of War Minister Judah Benjamin and President Davis.

zh: 临时政府的大部分运作开销可能是由肯塔基州联邦众议员伊莱·梅特卡夫·布鲁斯捐献，他在内战期间通过各种渠道发了大财。
en: Most of the operating expenses of the interim Government may have been contributed by the Federal Representative of the State of Kentucky, Ile Metcalf Bruce, who made substantial gains during the civil war through various channels.

zh: 飓风过去两天后，供电部门工作人员已经恢复了马里兰州东岸75%停电地区的供电，剩下的25%也在五天内全部恢复。
en: Two days after the hurricane, staff of the electricity sector have restored power supply to 75 per cent of the power outages on the eastern shore of Maryland County, with the remaining 25 per cent fully restored within five days.

zh: 哥伦比亚特区的多幢建筑物在风暴过去后还关闭了两天。
en: Many buildings in the District of Columbia were closed for two days after the storm.

zh: 马里兰州西部和中部有多人因在家中不恰当地操作发电机而出现一氧化碳中毒，有三人因此丧生。
en: Three people were killed as a result of carbon monoxide poisoning in the western and central part of Maryland, due to the inappropriate operation of generators at home.

zh: 此外还有人在清理废墟或使用链锯的过程中受伤。
en: In addition, people were injured in clearing the ruins or using chainsaws.

zh: 飓风来袭后，卡尔弗特县医院报告每天前来就诊的病人多了130位。
en: Following the hurricane, the Calvert District Hospital reported an additional 130 patients per day.

zh: 随着北太平洋的天气格局从秋末向冬初转变，季风槽产生的对流也延伸到国际日期变更线以东。
en: With the shift in weather patterns in the North Pacific from late autumn to early winter, the currents generated by monsoon troughs extend to the east of the international date change line.

zh: 1997年11月下旬，赤道两边的两条低压槽发展出西向扰动天气，其中位于南半球的系统最终发展成热带气旋帕姆，位于北半球的系统则在夏威夷州西南方向约2000公里海域催生出对流区。
en: In late November 1997, two low-pressure tanks on both sides of the equator developed westward disturbance weather, with systems in the southern hemisphere eventually developing into tropical cyclone Pam, while those in the northern hemisphere produced a converse zone to about 2,000 kilometres south-west of Hawaii.

zh: 这股扰动天气在向北偏东飘移期间逐渐组织，于11月28日在帕迈拉环礁西偏北方向约465公里洋面发展成1997年太平洋飓风季的第五C号热带低气压。
en: This disturbance, which was gradually organized during a north-easterly drift, evolved on 28 November into tropical low air pressure 5C in the 1997 Pacific hurricane season, some 465 kilometres north-west of Pamela Atoll.

zh: 不过，中太平洋飓风中心在实际操作中要到12月2日才开始针对系统发布警报。
en: However, the Central Pacific Hurricane Centre did not begin to issue alarms against the system until 2 December.

zh: 巴哈马曾在两周前受到飓风多里安重创，幸而热带风暴温贝托很大程度上只是虚惊一场。
en: The Bahamas was hit by hurricane Dorian two weeks ago, fortunately by tropical storm Wembeto, which was largely a false alarm.

zh: 气旋从东侧经过期间，位于该国西北部的格兰德巴哈马国际机场所测持续风速只有每小时46公里，降水也很少。
en: During the cyclone's passage from the east, the sustained wind speed measured at Grand Bahama International Airport, located in the north-west of the country, was only 46 kilometres per hour, with very little precipitation.

zh: 风暴逼近灾区期间，用于分发应急物资的小型机场短暂关闭。
en: The small airport used to distribute emergency supplies was temporarily closed during the storm approaching the affected areas.

zh: 1944年中期，美国海军开始要求用B-29轰炸机在日本列岛水域投放水雷，加强封锁。
en: In mid 1944, the United States Navy began to demand that mines be dropped on the waters of the Japanese islands by B-29 bombers and that the blockade be tightened.

zh: 阿诺德和幕僚对此不以为然，觉得这类任务需要占用大量超级堡垒轰炸机，影响精确空袭力度。
en: Arnold and his staff were not convinced of this, and felt that such missions required the use of a large number of super fort bombers, affecting the intensity of accurate air strikes.

zh: 海军一再提议之下，阿诺德于1944年11月决定在拥有充足飞机后开始布雷。
en: On the basis of repeated proposals by the Navy, Arnold decided in November 1944 to begin laying mines after having sufficient aircraft.

zh: 1945年1月，李梅选定第313轰炸联队专门负责第二十航空队的布雷任务，海军协助培训和后勤作业。
en: In January 1945, Li Mei selected the unit 313 to be dedicated to the laying of mines for the 20th Air Force, and the Navy assisted in training and logistical operations.

zh: 李梅为空中布雷指定代号“饥饿行动”。
en: Li Mei designated Operation Hunger as a code-name for aerial minefields.

zh: 美国此前仅偶尔使用水雷，所以日军对扫雷部队缺乏重视，导致大日本帝国海军对美国陆军航空军的大规模攻势猝不及防。
en: The United States had used mines only occasionally before, and the Japanese army's lack of attention to demining forces had led to a massive offensive by the Japanese Imperial Navy against the United States Army Air Force.

zh: 宝琳佩戴的饰品包括项链、流苏耳环和两腕都有的手镯。
en: Pauline wears a necklace, a lewd earring and a bracelet with both wrists.

zh: 脖子上的吊坠带有扁形十字架，代表她对信仰的虔诚，估计是由福图纳托·皮奥·卡斯特拉尼或麦兰瑞设计。
en: The crutches on her neck are flat crosses, representing her faith in faith, and are presumably designed by Fortunato Pio Castrani or Mallandri.

zh: 她的耳环是用多层小颗天然珍珠串成，左手腕上还有绳状珍珠手链，右手腕上的手链由红色珐琅和镶钻金链制成。
en: Her earring was made of small layers of natural pearls, with a stringed pearl bracelet on her left wrist and a chain of red and diamondd gold on her right wrist.

zh: 项链是串起金质吊坠的双环链，吊坠看起来应该是年代久远的罗马护身符。
en: The necklace is a double chain of gold locket, which looks like an old Roman amulet.

zh: 大卫·布劳沃德1938年出版的纪念币主题著作中称，长岛三百周年半美元的设计因缺乏新意恶评如潮，因为之前多种类似主题的长岛纪念币同样刻有双人头像和船只。
en: In his 1938 book on the theme of commemorative coins, David Brawward stated that the three and a half cents of Long Island's dollar had been designed for lack of novelty and ill-advised, since the long island commemorative coins of many similar topics had been carved with double headers and boats.

zh: 美术史学家科尼利厄斯·弗缪尔在1971年出版的美国钱币和奖章主题著作中表示，这款硬币正面的荷兰移民“看上去就像莎士比亚笔下的平民角色，印第安人则太显壮实，似乎能轻松胜任美国各地周日下午举办的职业美式橄榄球赛”。
en: In a book published in 1971 on the subject of American coins and medals, the art historian Cornelius Vmuel stated that the Dutch immigrant, who had a positive coin, “looks like Shakespeare's civilian role, and the Indians are too strong to seem ready to compete for the professional American football game held throughout the United States on Sunday afternoon”.

zh: 在他看来，这都是些“试图把传统构想现代化的老把戏”。
en: In his view, these were “old tricks to try to modernize traditional ideas”.

zh: 不过弗缪尔对背面颇有好感，觉得刻画船只的简单线条恰到好处，铭文淡入背景图案的处理方式也令人满意。
en: However, Fumuel had a good feeling about the back, thought that a simple line depicting the ship was appropriate, and that the text was being treated satisfactorily.

zh: 1960年男子4×100米混合泳接力成为奥运会比赛项目以来，美国队每次都能以显著优势取胜，与亚军相比最小的优势也有2.6秒，1972和1976年的优势分别是4.1和3.72秒，所以美国队抵制奥运会让其他国家代表团看到希望。
en: Since 1960, when the combined 4x100 metre swim relay of men became an Olympic match, the United States team has been able to win with a significant advantage of 2.6 seconds compared to the army, and in 1972 and 1976 the advantage was 4.1 and 3.72 seconds, respectively.

zh: 澳大利亚队自项目设立以来的五次奥运会都有参与，其中在罗马的首秀成绩最好，戴维·锡尔、特里·盖瑟科尔、内维尔·海斯、杰夫·希普顿以微弱优势超过日本获亚军。
en: The five Olympic Games since the establishment of the Australian team have all been involved, with the best performances in Rome, with David Syll, Terry Gesell, Neville Hayes and Jeff Shipton gaining a small advantage over Japan.

zh: 四年后，彼得·雷诺兹、伊恩·奥布莱恩、凯文·贝里、戴维·迪克森在1964年东京奥运会取得铜牌。
en: Four years later, Peter Reynolds, Ian O'Brien, Kevin Barry and David Dixon won the medal at the Tokyo Olympic Games in 1964.

zh: 此后两次奥运会一次排第四，另一次在热身赛即遭淘汰，1976年在蒙特利尔排名第六。
en: After that, two Olympic Games were ranked fourth, and another one was phased out in a warm-up race, ranking sixth in Montreal in 1976.

zh: 1976年接力赛的四名选手中，只有克里前往莫斯科参赛。
en: Of the four candidates in the 1976 relay, only Kerry went to Moscow.

zh: 7月20日，一股东风波的残留进入墨西哥湾东部，该海域次日就有一片低气压区形成并发展成热带低气压。
en: On 20 July, a residual of a shareholder windwave entered the eastern Gulf of Mexico, where the following day a low-pressure zone formed and developed into tropical low-pressure areas.

zh: 在弱转向气流的影响下，热带低气压向东南方向飘移，然后先转向东北，之后又转朝东进。
en: Under the influence of a weak shift to the air current, tropical low pressure moves south-east, then north-east and then eastward.

zh: 根据飓风猎人侦察机的报告，系统于7月22日晚增强成热带风暴并因此获命名为“鲍勃”。
en: According to the hurricane hunter reconnaissance aircraft, the system was enhanced to tropical storm on the night of 22 July and was named “Bob”.

zh: 鲍勃在向东经过墨西哥湾的过程中未能得到显著增强，于7月23日以风速每小时70公里强度从那不勒斯和麦尔兹堡之间地区登陆，这时系统中的大部分对流都集中在中心南部和东部。
en: Bob, who was unable to make a significant increase in his eastward passage through the Gulf of Mexico, landed on 23 July at a wind speed of 70 kilometres per hour from the area between Naples and Marzburg, when most of the system's convection was concentrated in the south and east of the centre.

zh: 波美拉尼亚号战列舰是德意志帝国海军于1904年至1906年间建造的五艘德国级前无畏战列舰之一，以普鲁士时期的省份波美拉尼亚命名。
en: The Pomerania battleship was one of five German-class ex-dauntless battleships built by the German Imperial Navy between 1904 and 1906 and named after the Prussia province of Pomerania.

zh: 它于1904年3月22日在斯德丁的伏尔铿船厂开始进行龙骨架设，1905年12月2日下水，至1907年8月6日交付海军使用。
en: On 22 March 1904, it began the construction of a dragon skeleton at the Voldemort shipyard in Steddin, went into water on 2 December 1905 and was handed over to the Navy on 6 August 1907.

zh: 舰只装备有四门280毫米主炮，最高航速为18节（33千米每小时）。
en: The ship was equipped with four 280 mm main guns with a maximum speed of 18 knots (33 km/hour).

zh: 其所在的舰级在入役之初便已沦为过时，无论在尺寸、装甲、火力和速度上都不如英国革命性的“全装重型火炮”战列舰无畏号战列舰。
en: Its class has become obsolete at the beginning of its service, and is not as large, armoured, firepower and speed as the British revolutionary battleship Full of Heavy Guns.

zh: 该舰同样有数次在波罗的海展开针对俄国海军的行动，其中首次是在里加湾海战期间对德国海军的进攻提供支援。
en: The vessel also carried out several operations against the Russian Navy in the Baltic Sea, the first of which was in support of an attack on the German Navy during the Gulf of Riga.

zh: 它于1918年再度重返波罗的海，以援助芬兰内战中的芬兰白卫队。
en: It returned to the Baltic Sea in 1918 to assist the Finnish White Guard in the Finnish civil war.

zh: 在战争结束时，波森号获准留在了德国，而公海舰队的大部分主力舰则被扣押至英国斯卡帕湾。
en: At the end of the war, the Bossen was allowed to remain in Germany, while most of the main ship in the high seas fleet was detained in the Gulf of Skapa, England.

zh: 至1919年，随着公海舰队在斯卡帕湾自沉，该舰代替已沉没的舰只被移交协约国。
en: By 1919, as the high seas fleet sank itself in Skapa Bay, it had been handed over only to the Treaty States in lieu of the sank ship.

zh: 最终，它被送往荷兰的拆船商，于1922年拆解报废。
en: Eventually, it was sent to the Dutch shipbreaking vessel and scrapped in 1922.

zh: 有四艘皇帝级战列舰参加了在1916年5月31日至6月1日爆发的日德兰海战。
en: Four Imperial battleships took part in the Zhdran War, which broke out from 31 May to 1 June 1916.

zh: 该行动试图复制此前的计划，对大舰队的一部分进行牵扯和摧毁。
en: The operation sought to replicate previous plans to involve and destroy part of the fleet.

zh: 皇帝号、皇后号、柳特波德摄政王号，以及舍尔的旗舰腓特烈大帝号组成了第三战列分舰队的第六支队。
en: The Emperor, the Queen, the Regent Lyutpod and the flagship of the Sher, the Great Philips, formed the sixth legion of the Third Platoon.

zh: 第三分舰队是3个战列舰部队之首，然而，该分舰队第四支队的国王级战列舰才是舰队的先锋。
en: The third leg of the fleet is the first of the three battleships, but the king-class warship of the fourth leg of the fleet is the vanguard of the fleet.

zh: 皇帝级紧随其后，它们的后方是第二战列分舰队的黑尔戈兰级和拿骚级；殿后部队则由第一战列分舰队年迈的德国级前无畏舰组成。
en: Following the Imperial rank, they were followed by the Helgoran and Nassau divisions of the Second Platoon, while the rear wing consisted of the old German-class ex-daunted ships of the First Platoon.

zh: 对于奴隶制问题，最高法院本来的原则是尽量自我克制。
en: With regard to slavery, the Supreme Court was originally based on the principle of maximum self-restraint.

zh: 1842年“普里格诉宾夕法尼亚州案”，斯托里大法官间接触碰了奴隶制问题，当时他代表最高法院撰写的判词推翻了宾夕法尼亚的一项州法。
en: In the case of Prigg v. Pennsylvania in 1842, the matter of slavery was touched by contact between Lord Stori, who, on behalf of the Supreme Court, overturned a state law in Pennsylvania.

zh: 他说，这项法律与联邦的逃奴法相冲突；接着，他没有什么理由就裁定触及逃奴的任何州法都是无效的；只是简单地说联邦政府对于这一问题拥有排他性的权力。
en: He stated that the law was in conflict with the federal law on escape; that he then had no reason to rule that any state law that touched on escape was null and void; and simply that the federal Government had exclusive powers on the matter.

zh: 因为联邦执法需要州的配合，这样实际上是在维护联邦权力的幌子下，阻止了对逃奴的拘捕。
en: Because federal law enforcement requires the cooperation of the Länder, it effectively prevents the arrest of fugitive slaves under the guise of upholding federal power.

zh: 在1850年的“斯特雷德诉格雷厄姆案”中，大法官回避了棘手的难题，也是只简单裁定，一个奴隶进入自由州后是否自动获得自由的问题应由他当时所居住的州（肯塔基州）法院判决，既然肯塔基州认为他是奴隶，那么他就是奴隶；争议中的黑人身份仅归结到他们目前所居住的州（肯塔基州）的法律，而不去涉及以前在自由地区寄居时的身份。
en: In the 1850 Streed v. Graham case, the Chief Justice avoided the difficult issue and simply ruled that the question of whether a slave automatically obtained his freedom upon entering the Free State was a matter for the court of the state in which he was living (Kentaki State) and that, since Kentucky considered him to be a slave, he would be a slave; the disputed black status was attributed only to the law of the state in which they currently lived (Kentaki State) and not to the status of a former resident in a free area.

zh: 尼克松来自一个中产阶级家庭，从法学院毕业后大部分时间都花在参军入伍、竞选公职和在国会服务上。
en: Nixon comes from a middle-class family and spends most of his time graduating from law school in military service, running for office and serving in Congress.

zh: 1950年成功当选联邦参议员后，尼克松的支持者继续筹集资金资助他的政治活动。
en: Following his successful election as a federal senator in 1950, Nixon ' s supporters continued to raise funds to finance his political activities.

zh: 2月22日，决心号和发现号在克拉克的指挥下重新出发，再一次前往白令海峡，试图继续履行库克寻找西北航道的任务。
en: On 22 February, the Determined and Discovery re-engaged under Clark ' s command to travel again to the Bering Strait in an attempt to continue the Cook search for the north-west channel.

zh: 可是在8月22日，克拉克自己却在距离堪察加半岛不远的海域因结核病病逝。
en: On 22 August, however, Clark himself died of tuberculosis in a sea not far from the Kamchatka peninsula.

zh: 数日后，戈尔于8月25日正式接任决心号舰长一职，而发现号舰长则由决心号二级上尉詹姆斯·金恩出任。
en: A few days later, on 25 August, Gore formally took over the post of Captain Reed, while Captain James King of the Discovery II was appointed.

zh: 此后，决心号和发现号放弃探索西北航道的计划，并决定启程返国。
en: Since then, Determined and Discovery has abandoned its plans to explore the north-west channel and has decided to return home.

zh: 两舰由阿瓦恰湾出发，一路沿日本、福尔摩沙、担杆列岛和澳门南下至南海，然后由巽他海峡穿过印度洋，再经好望角驶入大西洋，经过长时间的航行，最终在1780年10月7日返抵英国伦敦，正式为前后超过四年的航程划上句号。
en: The two ships departed from the Gulf of Ahuacha and travelled along the Japanese, Formosa, Jigsaw Island and Macau southwards to the South Sea, then through the Indian Ocean through the Zita Channel and into the Atlantic Ocean through the Cape of the Zhutai region. After a long voyage, they returned to London, England, on 7 October 1780, officially marking the end of a voyage lasting more than four years.

zh: 库克与克拉克的死讯早在决心号和发现号返国前已传至英国，因此两舰返国的消息未有引起很大震撼，而库克生前撰写关于第三次航海的周记，则由金恩返国后加以整理和发表。
en: The death of Cook and Clark was sent to the United Kingdom long before the return of the Resolute and Discovery, so the return of the two ships did not cause much shock, while Cook wrote a weekly report on the third voyage, which was collated and published by King upon his return.

zh: 在《女权》中，沃斯通克拉夫特针对虚伪泛滥的感性（特别是当时的女性带有的）进行了十分严厉的批评。
en: In Feminism, Woston Claft has been very harshly critical of the sense of hypocrisy, especially with women at the time.

en: In her view, a woman who was submissive to her senses “even instantaneously lost her emotions” would cause her to drift; because such a woman was “a victim of their senses”, they could not think rationally.

en: In fact, not only did they harm themselves, but they also did harm to civilization as a whole: They cannot allow civilization to move towards elegance, but rather towards destruction.

en: For Woston Clought and for a major philosopher of the 18th century, passion is the foundation of all of its rationality.
